description.zh: 了解罗马法成为欧洲及其他地区法律体系的基础；拉丁语是法语、西班牙语、意大利语、葡萄牙语和罗马尼亚语的根源，并为英语提供了数百个单词（如exit、video、annual、education）；基督教在罗马帝国传播，最终在君士坦丁大帝统治下成为官方宗教。
description.en: Understand that Roman law became the basis for legal systems across Europe and beyond, that Latin is the root of French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and Romanian and gave English hundreds of words (e.g. exit, video, annual, education), and that Christianity spread throughout the Roman Empire, eventually becoming its official religion under Emperor Constantine

evidence.zh: 能举例说明源自拉丁语的英语单词。
evidence.en: Give examples of English words that come from Latin

evidence.zh: 阐述罗马法对欧洲及其他地区现代法律体系的影响。
evidence.en: Explain that Roman law influenced modern legal systems in Europe and beyond

evidence.zh: 概述基督教在罗马帝国的传播及其国教化的历程
evidence.en: Describe how Christianity spread through the Roman Empire and became its official religion

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否举例说明源自拉丁语的英语单词，并解释罗马法和基督教是如何通过罗马帝国传播到欧洲各地的？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} give you examples of English words that come from Latin and explain how Roman law and Christianity spread across Europe through the Roman Empire?

name.zh: 罗马共和国与罗马帝国

description.zh: 解释罗马最初如何作为共和国进行统治——设有选举产生的执政官、权力强大的元老院，以及贵族与平民之间的区分——后来又如何变成由奥古斯都（他带来了“罗马和平”）和尼禄等皇帝统治的帝国，并比较共和制政府与雅典的直接民主制。
description.en: Explain how Rome was first governed as a republic — with elected consuls, a powerful Senate, and a distinction between patricians and plebeians — before becoming an empire ruled by emperors like Augustus (who brought peace, the Pax Romana) and Nero, and compare republican government with Athenian direct democracy

evidence.zh: 描述罗马共和国的结构：执政官、元老院、贵族与平民
evidence.en: Describe the Roman Republic's structure: consuls, Senate, patricians, and plebeians

evidence.zh: 描述奥古斯都统治下罗马从共和国向帝国的转变。
evidence.en: Explain how Rome changed from a republic to an empire under Augustus

evidence.zh: 比较雅典的直接民主（公民直接投票决定事务）与罗马的共和制政府（公民选举代表参与治理）。
evidence.en: Compare Athenian direct democracy (citizens vote on decisions) with Roman republican government (citizens elect representatives)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释罗马共和国与罗马帝国的区别，并比较罗马和雅典各自是如何让人民在政府中拥有发言权的？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain the difference between the Roman Republic and the Roman Empire, and compare how Rome and Athens each let people have a say in government?

name.zh: 希腊与罗马的隐藏声音
name.en: Hidden Voices of Greece and Rome

description.zh: 考察那些通常被排除在希腊罗马历史叙事之外的人群的生活——约占雅典人口30%并为罗马经济提供动力的被奴役者，在雅典（主要被限制在家中）和斯巴达（接受体能训练、拥有财产）之间生活差异巨大的女性，以及两个帝国中被征服的民族——并评估历史记录中缺失了谁的声音以及原因。
description.en: Examine the lives of people usually left out of the Greek and Roman story — enslaved people who made up roughly 30% of Athens and powered Rome's economy, women whose lives varied dramatically between Athens (largely confined to the home) and Sparta (physical training, property ownership), and conquered peoples across both empires — and evaluate whose voices are missing from the historical record and why

evidence.zh: 运用现有史料，描述雅典或罗马奴隶的日常生活。
evidence.en: Describe the daily life of an enslaved person in Athens or Rome using available evidence

evidence.zh: 比较雅典与斯巴达妇女的生活，并解释其主要差异。
evidence.en: Compare the lives of women in Athens and Sparta, explaining key differences

evidence.zh: 解释历史记录为何偏向精英男性，及其对历史理解的影响
evidence.en: Explain why the historical record favours elite men and what this means for our understanding

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否向你讲述古希腊和古罗马奴隶或女性的生活，并解释为什么我们对他们的了解少于对著名领袖的了解？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you about the lives of enslaved people or women in ancient Greece and Rome, and explain why we know less about them than about famous leaders?

description.zh: 分析雅典民主制度中谁被包容、谁被排斥——只有自由的成年男性公民（约占成年人的30%）才能参与，而妇女、被奴役的人（可能占人口的三分之一）和外国居民（外邦人）都被排斥——并通过与现代代议制民主的比较，评价雅典是否真正配得上“民主发源地”的称号。
description.en: Analyse who was included and excluded from Athenian democracy — only free adult male citizens (roughly 30% of adults) could participate, while women, enslaved people (who may have made up a third of the population), and foreign residents (metics) were excluded — and evaluate whether Athens truly deserves the title 'birthplace of democracy' by comparing it with modern representative democracies

evidence.zh: 估算雅典约有多大比例的人口能够参与民主。
evidence.en: Calculate approximately what fraction of the Athenian population could participate in democracy

evidence.zh: 列举被排除在雅典民主政治之外的社会群体，并说明其被排除的原因。
evidence.en: List the groups excluded from Athenian democracy and explain why each was excluded

evidence.zh: 运用证据，构建支持或反对雅典是真正民主制的论证。
evidence.en: Construct an argument for or against calling Athens a true democracy, using evidence

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释雅典民主制将谁排除在外，并就其是否真正配得上“民主发源地”这一称号提出有理有据的论证？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain who was left out of Athenian democracy and make a reasoned argument about whether it really deserves to be called the birthplace of democracy?

description.zh: 探索海因里希·施利曼在土耳其希沙立克的发掘如何引发疑问：荷马《伊利亚特》中描述的特洛伊战争是真实的历史、部分真实，还是完全虚构？理解考古学和文学资料可能相互支持或矛盾，古代世界中神话与历史的界限往往模糊不清。
description.en: Explore how Heinrich Schliemann's excavation at Hisarlik in modern Turkey raised questions about whether the Trojan War described in Homer's Iliad was historical, partly historical, or entirely mythical — understanding that archaeology and literary sources can support or contradict each other, and that the line between myth and history in the ancient world is often blurred

evidence.zh: 描述谢里曼在希沙立克的发掘及其声称的发现
evidence.en: Describe Schliemann's excavation at Hisarlik and what he claimed to have found

evidence.zh: 解释特洛伊考古证据如何既支持又使荷马史诗的叙述复杂化
evidence.en: Explain how archaeological evidence at Troy both supports and complicates Homer's story

evidence.zh: 能探讨古代世界神话与历史难以界分的原因
evidence.en: Discuss why the boundary between myth and history is difficult to draw for the ancient world

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否讨论特洛伊战争是否真实发生过，解释考古学在特洛伊遗址发现了什么，以及为什么这个问题没有简单的答案？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} discuss whether the Trojan War really happened, explaining what archaeology has found at Troy and why the answer isn't simple?

description.zh: 追溯罗马政治暴力——格拉古兄弟被杀、马略与苏拉的内战、凯撒跨越卢比孔河及三月十五日遇刺、屋大维与安东尼的最终决战——如何摧毁了共和国，并导致奥古斯都的一人统治，同时讨论共和国的衰亡是不可避免的，还是一系列选择的结果。
description.en: Trace how Roman political violence — the murder of the Gracchi brothers, civil wars between Marius and Sulla, Caesar's crossing of the Rubicon and assassination on the Ides of March, and the final war between Octavian and Antony — destroyed the Republic and led to one-man rule under Augustus, and debate whether the fall of the Republic was inevitable or a series of choices

evidence.zh: 按时间顺序列出罗马共和国灭亡的至少三个关键事件。
evidence.en: Describe at least three key events in the collapse of the Roman Republic in chronological order

evidence.zh: 解释“跨越卢比孔河”的含义及其为何成为不可逆转的转折点。
evidence.en: Explain what 'crossing the Rubicon' meant and why it was a point of no return

evidence.zh: 就罗马共和国的灭亡是否不可避免或本可避免，构建论证。
evidence.en: Construct an argument about whether the Republic's fall was inevitable or could have been prevented

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释从格拉古兄弟到凯撒遇刺再到奥古斯都这一连串导致罗马共和国覆灭的事件，并讨论这一过程是否本可避免？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain the chain of events that destroyed the Roman Republic — from the Gracchi to Caesar's assassination to Augustus — and discuss whether it could have been avoided?

name.en: Different Accounts of the Same Event

description.zh: 认识到不同的人对同一事件可以给出不同的描述——而且这些描述可能都是真实的，但仍然存在分歧。
description.en: Recognise that different people can give different accounts of the same event — and that both can be genuine while still disagreeing

evidence.zh: 温伯格互证启发式
evidence.en: Wineburg corroboration heuristic

evidence.zh: 在小学阶段初步形成历史思维
evidence.en: Initiating Historical Thinking in Elementary Schools

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}听到关于同一历史事件的两种不同说法，他们能否理解双方可能都是基于自身视角说出真话——并想了解为什么说法会有不同？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} heard two different versions of the same historical event, would they understand that both people might be telling the truth from their own point of view — and want to know why the versions differ?

description.zh: 理解我们对过去的所有了解都来自证据——保存下来的物品、建筑、图片、文件和故事
description.en: Understand that everything we know about the past comes from evidence — objects, buildings, pictures, documents, and stories that have survived

evidence.zh: 掌握温伯格历史思维框架
evidence.en: Wineburg historical thinking framework

evidence.zh: 小学阶段的历史思维（ERIC）
evidence.en: Historical Thinking in the Elementary Years (ERIC)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}了解到很久以前发生的事情时，是否会追问我们是如何知道的——并理解必须有人发现或留下这些证据？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} learns about something that happened long ago, do they ask how we know about it — and understand that someone had to find or leave behind that evidence?

description.zh: 认识并使用历史思维的词汇——史料、证据、一手史料、二手史料、文物、年代学、时间顺序、公元前/公元前、公元/公元、世纪、十年、时代、时期、时间线、发掘、考古学家、解读、印证、偏见、视角——并在讨论我们如何了解过去以及我们的知识有多可靠时运用这些术语。
description.en: Know and use the vocabulary of historical thinking — source, evidence, primary source, secondary source, artefact, chronology, chronological order, BC/BCE, AD/CE, century, decade, era, period, timeline, excavation, archaeologist, interpretation, corroborate, bias, perspective — and apply these terms when discussing how we know about the past and how reliable our knowledge is

evidence.zh: 正确使用BC/BCE和AD/CE将事件置于时间轴中，并解释各字母含义。
evidence.en: Correctly use BC/BCE and AD/CE to place events in time and explain what the letters stand for

evidence.zh: 能区分一手资料与二手资料，并能分别举例说明。
evidence.en: Distinguish between a primary source and a secondary source with an example of each

evidence.zh: 能在历史材料相关语句中正确运用“证据”“解读”和“偏见”。
evidence.en: Use 'evidence', 'interpretation', and 'bias' correctly in a sentence about a historical source

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你问{{name}}，他们在历史书上读到的内容是否一定真实，他们能否用“来源”“证据”或“偏见”这样的词来解释为什么它可能并不一定真实？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you asked {{name}} whether something they read in a history book was definitely true, could they explain why it might not be — using words like 'source', 'evidence', or 'bias'?

description.zh: 相互印证：检查多个资料是否对同一事实说法一致——并探究它们可能不一致的原因
description.en: Corroborate: check whether multiple sources agree on the same facts — and investigate why they might not

evidence.zh: 温伯格互证启发式
evidence.en: Wineburg corroboration heuristic

evidence.zh: 小学阶段的历史思维（ERIC）
evidence.en: Historical Thinking in the Elementary Years (ERIC)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}想要弄清一个历史事件的真相，他们是否知道要查阅不止一个来源，并比较这些来源的说法？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} was trying to find out what really happened in a historical event, would they know to look at more than one source and compare what they say?

description.zh: 在相信一份历史资料之前，先问：这是谁做的、什么时候做的、为什么做？——这些答案决定了这份资料应该有多大的可信度。
description.en: Before trusting a historical source, ask: who made this, when, and why? — the answers shape how much weight the source should carry

evidence.zh: 掌握温伯格史料溯源策略
evidence.en: Wineburg sourcing heuristic

evidence.zh: 运用原始资料进行历史思维教学（美国国会图书馆）
evidence.en: Teaching Historical Thinking Using Primary Sources (Library of Congress)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}查看一份历史文献、照片或叙述时，是否会追问作者是谁，以及其动机或观点可能是什么？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} looks at a historical document, photograph, or account, do they ask who created it and what that person's reasons or point of view might have been?

name.en: Understanding People in Their Own Time

description.zh: 明白过去的人看待世界的方式与我们非常不同——要根据他们所处的时代背景来评判他们的行为，而不仅仅是用今天的价值观来衡量。
description.en: Understand that people in the past saw the world very differently from us — judge their actions by the context they lived in, not only by today's values

evidence.zh: 历史共情：认知—情感理论（ERIC）
evidence.en: Historical Empathy: A Cognitive-Affective Theory (ERIC)

evidence.zh: 4-6年级历史共情探究
evidence.en: Year 4-6 historical empathy research

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}了解到过去的人做过一些在今天看来不对的事情，他们能否思考为什么当时那些人可能认为这是正常的或正确的？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} learns that people in the past did something that seems wrong today, can they think about why those people might have believed it was normal or right at the time?

description.zh: 区分历史证据和历史解释——证据是留存下来的材料，解释是历史学家基于证据构建的论点，同样的证据可以支持不同的论点。
description.en: Distinguish between historical evidence and historical interpretation — evidence is what survived, interpretation is the argument a historian builds from it, and the same evidence can support different arguments

evidence.zh: 9-14岁学生历史理解能力的培养
evidence.en: Development of historical understanding among 9-14 year olds

evidence.zh: 观察之道：历史课堂中的证据与学习（RRCHNM）
evidence.en: Ways of Seeing: Evidence and Learning in the History Classroom (RRCHNM)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}是否理解，两位历史学家可以基于同样的史料得出不同的结论——而历史不仅涉及事实，还涉及论证与判断？
assessmentPrompt.en: Does {{name}} understand that two historians can look at the same evidence and reach different conclusions — and that history involves argument and judgment, not just facts?

description.zh: 中世纪国王和王后做什么：统治土地、制定法律、收税；王冠和王座作为权力的象征；伦敦塔
description.en: What medieval kings and queens did: ruling the land, making laws, collecting taxes; the crown and throne as symbols of power; the Tower of London

evidence.zh: 描述中世纪国王或女王的主要职责（统治、立法、统率军队、征税）
evidence.en: Explain what a medieval king or queen did (ruled, made laws, led armies, collected taxes)

evidence.zh: 至少描述一种王权象征（王冠、王座或权杖）
evidence.en: Describe at least one symbol of royal power (crown, throne, sceptre)

evidence.zh: 能说出中世纪一位著名君主的名字，或描述伦敦塔的用途。
evidence.en: Name one famous medieval monarch or describe the Tower of London's role

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释一下，在中世纪，国王或女王除了戴王冠之外，实际上还做些什么？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain what a king or queen actually did in medieval times, beyond just wearing a crown?

description.zh: 骑士是什么：为领主效力的受过训练的战士；盔甲、盾牌、剑和长矛；骑士准则作为骑士行为规范的规则
description.en: What knights were: trained warriors who served a lord; armour, shields, swords, and lances; the code of chivalry as rules for how knights should behave

evidence.zh: 描述骑士的盔甲与装备（盔甲、头盔、盾牌、剑、长矛）
evidence.en: Describe what a knight wore and carried (armour, helmet, shield, sword, lance)

evidence.zh: 能说明骑士从小接受训练并效忠领主。
evidence.en: Explain that knights trained from a young age and served a lord

evidence.zh: 能说出骑士准则中的一项（勇敢、诚实、保护弱者）
evidence.en: Name one rule of the code of chivalry (be brave, be honest, protect the weak)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否描述骑士的外貌、他们的职责，以及至少一条他们应当遵守的规则？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} describe what a knight looked like, what they did, and at least one rule they were supposed to follow?

description.zh: 中世纪人们穿什么：农民的衣服（羊毛、亚麻）与贵族的衣服（丝绸、毛皮、鲜艳的颜色）；没有拉链或纽扣；衣服如何显示你的社会地位
description.en: What people wore in medieval times: peasant clothes (wool, linen) vs noble clothes (silk, fur, bright colours); no zippers or buttons; how clothes showed your place in society

evidence.zh: 描述中世纪农民常见的服饰。
evidence.en: Describe what a medieval peasant would typically wear

evidence.zh: 能说明贵族服饰与农民服饰的区别
evidence.en: Explain how noble clothing was different from peasant clothing

evidence.zh: 请举例说明你的穿着如何体现你的社会地位。
evidence.en: Give one way that what you wore showed your place in society

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}看不同中世纪人物的图片，他们能仅凭衣着就判断出哪些人富有、哪些人贫穷吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} saw pictures of different medieval people, could they tell you which ones were rich and which were poor just by looking at their clothes?

description.zh: 中世纪人们吃什么：普通人吃面包和浓汤，富人举办盛大宴会；没有叉子，用手吃饭；大厅是城堡生活的中心。
description.en: What people ate in medieval times: bread and pottage for ordinary people, grand feasts for the rich; no forks, eating with hands; the great hall as the centre of castle life

evidence.zh: 说出普通人日常的主要食物（面包、浓汤、蔬菜、麦酒）
evidence.en: Describe what ordinary people ate most days (bread, pottage, vegetables, ale)

evidence.zh: 阐述宴席与日常餐食的区别。
evidence.en: Explain how a feast in a great hall was different from everyday meals

evidence.zh: 能列举一项中世纪令人意外的餐桌礼仪（如不用叉子、共用杯子、食物扔地上）。
evidence.en: Name one surprising table manner from medieval times (no forks, shared cups, food thrown on the floor)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}去参加一场中世纪宴会，他们能描述出宴会上会提供哪些食物，以及哪些餐桌礼仪会让他们感到惊讶吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} went to a medieval banquet, could they describe what food would be served and which table manners would surprise them?

description.zh: 罗宾汉的传说（舍伍德森林、劫富济贫、快乐伙伴）和亚瑟王的传说（圆桌骑士、王者之剑、卡美洛）；这些是故事，不是被证实的历史，但反映了中世纪价值观。
description.en: The legends of Robin Hood (Sherwood Forest, stealing from the rich, Merry Men) and King Arthur (Round Table, Excalibur, Camelot); that these are stories, not proven history, but reflect medieval values

evidence.zh: 复述罗宾汉或亚瑟王的基本故事
evidence.en: Retell the basic story of Robin Hood or King Arthur

evidence.zh: 能说出神话传说中至少两个人物。
evidence.en: Name at least two characters from one of these legends

evidence.zh: 能区分传说与史实。
evidence.en: Explain that these are legends (stories) rather than proven facts

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否向你讲述罗宾汉或亚瑟王的故事，并说明这些属于传说而非真实的历史？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you the story of Robin Hood or King Arthur and explain that these are legends rather than definitely true history?

description.zh: 维京人是谁：来自斯堪的纳维亚的航海战士和商人；长船；维京人对不列颠的袭击；维京人也定居和务农
description.en: Who the Vikings were: seafaring warriors and traders from Scandinavia; longships; Viking raids on Britain; that Vikings also settled and farmed

evidence.zh: 描述维京人的身份及其起源。
evidence.en: Describe who the Vikings were and where they came from

evidence.zh: 能说明长船的特点（速度快、可浅水航行、船首为龙首造型）
evidence.en: Explain what made longships special (fast, could sail in shallow water, dragon prows)

evidence.zh: 能说明维京人不仅是劫掠者，也是农民、商人和定居者。
evidence.en: State that Vikings were not just raiders but also farmers, traders, and settlers

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否说出维京人是谁、他们来自哪里，以及他们并非只是劫掠和战斗？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you who the Vikings were, where they came from, and that they did more than just raid and fight?

description.zh: 中世纪村庄里普通人的日常生活：茅草屋、种田、烤面包、打水；生活与今天有多么不同
description.en: Daily life for ordinary people in a medieval village: thatched houses, farming, baking bread, fetching water; how different life was from today

evidence.zh: 描述中世纪典型村庄的特征（茅草屋、田地、教堂）
evidence.en: Describe what a typical medieval village looked like (thatched cottages, fields, church)

evidence.zh: 至少列举三项中世纪村民的日常活动。
evidence.en: Name at least three daily tasks a medieval villager would do

evidence.zh: 说出中世纪村庄生活与今天生活的两点不同。
evidence.en: Give two differences between life in a medieval village and life today

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否描述中世纪村庄里一个孩子典型的一天是怎样的，以及这与他们自己的生活有何不同？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} describe what a normal day would be like for a child living in a medieval village, and how it would differ from their own life?

description.zh: 城堡是什么：一种既能住人又能防御的坚固建筑；城堡的主要部分包括塔楼、护城河、吊桥和厚厚的城墙；为什么要建造城堡
description.en: What a castle is: a fortified building used as both a home and a defence; key parts including towers, moat, drawbridge, and thick walls; why castles were built

evidence.zh: 能说出城堡的至少四个组成部分（塔楼、护城河、吊桥、城墙、门楼）。
evidence.en: Name at least four parts of a castle (tower, moat, drawbridge, walls, gatehouse)

evidence.zh: 阐述城堡的居住与防御双重功能
evidence.en: Explain that castles were both homes and defences

evidence.zh: 描述中世纪时期人们需要城堡的原因
evidence.en: Describe why someone in medieval times would need a castle

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}参观了一座城堡废墟，他们能否指出其主要部分并解释其为何如此建造？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} visited a ruined castle, could they point out the main parts and explain why it was built that way?

name.zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊时期的英国

description.zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊人是谁：罗马人离开后定居不列颠的日耳曼民族；他们的王国、村庄、地名、艺术，以及最终皈依基督教
description.en: Who the Anglo-Saxons were: Germanic peoples who settled in Britain after the Romans left; their kingdoms, villages, place names, art, and eventual conversion to Christianity

evidence.zh: 解释盎格鲁-撒克逊人的身份及其在不列颠的定居时间（罗马人撤离后）。
evidence.en: Explain who the Anglo-Saxons were and when they came to Britain (after the Romans left)

evidence.zh: 能列举至少两个盎格鲁-撒克逊王国（如韦塞克斯、麦西亚、诺森布里亚）。
evidence.en: Name at least two Anglo-Saxon kingdoms (e.g. Wessex, Mercia, Northumbria)

evidence.zh: 能举例说明至今仍可见的盎格鲁-撒克逊影响（如以-ton、-ham、-bury结尾的地名）
evidence.en: Give an example of Anglo-Saxon influence still visible today (place names ending in -ton, -ham, -bury)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释盎格鲁-撒克逊人是谁，并指出许多英国地名源自盎格鲁-撒克逊词汇？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain who the Anglo-Saxons were and point out that many English place names come from Anglo-Saxon words?

description.zh: 1066年发生的大事：忏悔者爱德华去世、三个人争夺王位、黑斯廷斯战役、征服者威廉，以及作为历史资料的贝叶挂毯。
description.en: The events of 1066: the death of Edward the Confessor, three claimants to the throne, the Battle of Hastings, William the Conqueror, and the Bayeux Tapestry as a historical source

evidence.zh: 解释为何1066年忏悔者爱德华去世后引发了继承危机。
evidence.en: Explain why there was a crisis when Edward the Confessor died in 1066

evidence.zh: 描述黑斯廷斯战役及其结果
evidence.en: Describe the Battle of Hastings and its outcome

evidence.zh: 阐述贝叶挂毯的内容，并说明其史料价值。
evidence.en: Explain what the Bayeux Tapestry is and why it is important as a historical source

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否说出1066年发生了什么、为什么重要，以及贝叶挂毯向我们展示了关于这些事件的哪些信息？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you what happened in 1066, why it mattered, and what the Bayeux Tapestry shows us about those events?

description.zh: 城堡是如何建造和演变的：从木制土墩-外郭城堡到石制主楼，再到同心城堡；城堡的房间及其用途；城堡设计如何应对新的攻击方式。
description.en: How castles were built and evolved: from wooden motte-and-bailey to stone keeps to concentric castles; rooms and their uses; how castle design responded to new attack methods

evidence.zh: 描述早期城寨式城堡与后期石制城堡的区别
evidence.en: Describe the difference between an early motte-and-bailey castle and a later stone castle

evidence.zh: 能说出中世纪城堡至少三个房间或区域的名称及功能。
evidence.en: Name at least three rooms or areas in a medieval castle and their purpose

evidence.zh: 说明城堡设计为抵御新型攻击方式而演变的一种方式
evidence.en: Explain one way castle design changed to resist new attack methods

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释城堡是如何随时间演变的，并描述城堡内不同房间的功能？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain how castles changed over time and describe what different rooms inside a castle were used for?

description.zh: 中世纪社会是如何组织的：国王在最上面，然后是领主，然后是骑士，最后是农民/农奴；谁欠谁什么；权力金字塔和相互义务
description.en: How medieval society was organised: king at the top, then lords, then knights, then peasants/serfs; who owed what to whom; the pyramid of power and mutual obligations

evidence.zh: 能绘制或描述封建等级金字塔，体现国王、领主、骑士和农民。
evidence.en: Draw or describe the feudal pyramid showing king, lords, knights, and peasants

evidence.zh: 解释各阶层对上一阶层应尽的义务（效忠、兵役、劳役）
evidence.en: Explain what each level owed to the level above (loyalty, military service, labour)

evidence.zh: 描述农奴的生活状况及其难以摆脱的原因
evidence.en: Describe what a serf's life was like and why they couldn't easily leave

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释中世纪阶级制度——谁处于顶层，谁处于底层，以及每个群体必须为其他群体做什么？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain the medieval class system — who was at the top, who was at the bottom, and what each group had to do for the others?

description.zh: 城堡如何被攻击和防守：攻城武器（投石机、破城槌、攻城塔）、滚烫的液体、箭孔、谋杀孔；中世纪攻城战的戏剧性场面。
description.en: How castles were attacked and defended: siege weapons (trebuchets, battering rams, siege towers), boiling liquids, arrow slits, murder holes; the drama of a medieval siege

evidence.zh: 至少列举三种攻城武器或进攻方式
evidence.en: Name at least three siege weapons or attack methods

evidence.zh: 至少描述两种城堡防御进攻的设计方式
evidence.en: Describe at least two ways a castle was designed to resist attack

evidence.zh: 解释围城的定义，并说明围城为何可能持续数周或数月。
evidence.en: Explain what a siege was and why it could last weeks or months

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}正在阅读关于中世纪围攻的内容，他们能否解释用于攻击城堡的武器以及守方巧妙反击的方式？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} was reading about a medieval siege, could they explain the weapons used to attack a castle and the clever ways defenders fought back?

description.zh: 1348-49年的黑死病：什么是瘟疫，它是如何传播的，它造成的毁灭性死亡人数；它如何通过让幸存的工人获得更多权力和更高工资来改变社会。
description.en: The Black Death of 1348-49: what the plague was, how it spread, its devastating death toll; how it changed society by giving surviving workers more power and higher wages

evidence.zh: 能描述黑死病的定义，并至少列举两种症状。
evidence.en: Describe what the Black Death was and at least two symptoms

evidence.zh: 解释鼠疫的传播途径（鼠蚤叮咬、人际传播）
evidence.en: Explain how the plague spread (fleas on rats, person to person)

evidence.zh: 描述黑死病改变社会的一个主要方式（劳动力减少导致工资上涨，农民获得权力）
evidence.en: Describe one major way the Black Death changed society (fewer workers led to higher wages, peasants gained power)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否向你说明黑死病是什么、它是如何传播的，以及为什么它最终以出人意料的方式改变了社会？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you what the Black Death was, how it spread, and why it actually ended up changing society in unexpected ways?

description.zh: 用简单的方式讲述十字军东征：欧洲人为什么前往圣地，他们在那里发现了什么，以及基督教欧洲与伊斯兰世界之间的文化交流。
description.en: A simplified account of the Crusades: why Europeans travelled to the Holy Land, what they found there, the cultural exchange between Christian Europe and the Islamic world

evidence.zh: 能用自己的话通俗易懂地解释欧洲军队远征圣地的原因。
evidence.en: Explain in simple terms why European armies travelled to the Holy Land

evidence.zh: 至少列举一项欧洲人在十字军东征期间从伊斯兰世界学到的内容。
evidence.en: Describe at least one thing Europeans learned from the Islamic world during the Crusades

evidence.zh: 认识到十字军东征给双方都带来了暴力和苦难。
evidence.en: Acknowledge that the Crusades involved violence and suffering on both sides

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释什么是十字军东征，并描述欧洲人通过这些旅程了解到了关于更广阔世界的哪些事情？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain what the Crusades were and describe something that Europeans learned about the wider world through these journeys?

description.zh: 中世纪教会的巨大权力：修道院与修士修女的日常生活；建造宏伟的大教堂；朝圣作为宗教旅程；教会对日常生活的影响
description.en: The enormous power of the medieval Church: monasteries and the daily life of monks and nuns; building great cathedrals; pilgrimage as a religious journey; the Church's influence over everyday life

evidence.zh: 解释中世纪教会强大的原因（拥有土地、控制教育、民众畏惧上帝的惩罚）
evidence.en: Explain why the Church was so powerful in medieval times (owned land, controlled education, people feared God's punishment)

evidence.zh: 描述僧侣或修女的日常生活。
evidence.en: Describe what daily life was like for a monk or nun

evidence.zh: 解释朝圣的含义，并说明人们朝圣的一个原因。
evidence.en: Explain what a pilgrimage was and give one reason people went on them

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释一下为什么在中世纪教会是人们生活中如此重要的一部分，以及修士和修女们整天都做些什么？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain why the Church was such a big part of everyone's life in medieval times and what monks and nuns actually did all day?

name.zh: 维京人与盎格鲁-撒克逊人

description.zh: 维京人与盎格鲁-撒克逊人争夺英格兰控制权的冲突：维京人的劫掠、阿尔弗雷德大帝的抵抗、丹麦法区、首位全英格兰国王阿瑟尔斯坦、忏悔者爱德华
description.en: The conflict between Vikings and Anglo-Saxons for control of England: Viking raids, Alfred the Great's resistance, the Danelaw, Athelstan as first king of all England, Edward the Confessor

evidence.zh: 描述维京人对盎格鲁-撒克逊英格兰的劫掠及其影响
evidence.en: Describe the Viking raids on Anglo-Saxon England and their impact

evidence.zh: 阐述阿尔弗雷德大帝的身份及其历史意义。
evidence.en: Explain who Alfred the Great was and why he was important

evidence.zh: 描述丹麦法区（维京人统治下的英格兰地区）。
evidence.en: Describe what the Danelaw was (the area of England under Viking control)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否向你讲述维京人与盎格鲁-撒克逊人争夺英格兰控制权的斗争，以及阿尔弗雷德大帝是谁？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you about the struggle between the Vikings and Anglo-Saxons for control of England, and who Alfred the Great was?

description.zh: 中世纪的文化成就：泥金装饰手抄本、哥特式大教堂（飞扶壁、彩色玻璃）、格里高利圣咏、贝叶挂毯；艺术和建筑作为信仰与权力的表达
description.en: Medieval cultural achievements: illuminated manuscripts, Gothic cathedrals (flying buttresses, stained glass), Gregorian chant, the Bayeux Tapestry; art and architecture as expressions of faith and power

evidence.zh: 描述泥金装饰手抄本并说明其制作者。
evidence.en: Describe what an illuminated manuscript is and who made them

evidence.zh: 能说出哥特式大教堂建筑的两个特征（尖拱、飞扶壁、彩色玻璃窗）。
evidence.en: Name at least two features of Gothic cathedral architecture (pointed arches, flying buttresses, stained glass)

evidence.zh: 阐述中世纪艺术和建筑与教会及宗教信仰之间的联系。
evidence.en: Explain how medieval art and buildings were connected to the Church and religious belief

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}参观一座哥特式大教堂，他们能否指出彩色玻璃窗和飞扶壁等特征，并解释中世纪人们为何要建造如此宏伟的建筑？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} visited a Gothic cathedral, could they point out features like stained glass windows and flying buttresses and explain why medieval people built such impressive buildings?

description.zh: 中世纪时期的司法是如何运作的：神判法、决斗审判、郡长的角色；惩罚方式包括足枷、颈手枷和地牢；与现代司法有多么不同
description.en: How justice worked in medieval times: trial by ordeal, trial by combat, the role of the sheriff; punishments including stocks, pillory, and dungeons; how different it was from modern justice

evidence.zh: 至少描述两种中世纪判定有罪的方法（神判法、决斗审判）
evidence.en: Describe at least two medieval methods of deciding guilt (trial by ordeal, trial by combat)

evidence.zh: 能列举至少两种中世纪刑罚并说明其具体内容。
evidence.en: Name at least two medieval punishments and explain what they involved

evidence.zh: 比较中世纪司法制度与现代司法制度的某一特征。
evidence.en: Compare one aspect of medieval justice to how justice works today

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否描述中世纪罪犯是如何被抓获和惩罚的，并解释以今天的标准来看哪些做法显得不公平？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} describe how criminals were caught and punished in medieval times and explain what seems unfair by today's standards?

name.en: Magna Carta and Limiting Royal Power

description.zh: 约翰国王、男爵们的反抗，以及1215年《大宪章》的签署；《大宪章》如何限制国王的权力；它对民主和权利的持久重要性。
description.en: King John, the barons' revolt, and the sealing of the Magna Carta in 1215; what the Magna Carta said about limiting the king's power; its lasting importance for democracy and rights

evidence.zh: 解释男爵们反抗约翰国王的原因
evidence.en: Explain why the barons rebelled against King John

evidence.zh: 能说出《大宪章》的内容（国王也必须遵守法律，以及公平审判权）。
evidence.en: Describe what the Magna Carta said (the king must follow the law too, fair trial rights)

evidence.zh: 阐述《大宪章》作为民主与人权基石在当今的重要意义。
evidence.en: Explain why the Magna Carta still matters today (foundation of democracy and human rights)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否说出《大宪章》是什么，以及为什么一份1215年的文件至今仍被认为重要？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you what the Magna Carta is and why a document from 1215 is still considered important today?

name.zh: 中世纪对现代生活的影响

description.zh: 中世纪留给我们的遗产：议会、大学、普通法、哥特式建筑、英语（盎格鲁-撒克逊语+诺曼法语）、地名、姓氏；以及为什么我们至今仍对中世纪世界着迷
description.en: What the Middle Ages gave us: Parliament, universities, common law, Gothic architecture, the English language (Anglo-Saxon + Norman French), place names, surnames; why we are still fascinated by the medieval world

evidence.zh: 至少列举三项中世纪延续至今、仍影响我们生活的事物
evidence.en: Name at least three things from the Middle Ages that still affect our lives today

evidence.zh: 解释盎格鲁-撒克逊语和诺曼法语对英语形成的影响
evidence.en: Explain how the English language was shaped by Anglo-Saxon and Norman French

evidence.zh: 说出当代人仍对中世纪时期（城堡、骑士、奇幻文学、游戏）着迷的一个原因。
evidence.en: Give a reason why people today are still fascinated by the medieval period (castles, knights, fantasy literature, games)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否列举出几样我们今天仍在使用、却起源于中世纪的事物——从议会到英语单词，再到大学学位？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} name several things we still have today — from Parliament to English words to university degrees — that actually began in the Middle Ages?

name.zh: 欧洲之外的中世纪世界

description.zh: 欧洲之外的中世纪世界：伊斯兰黄金时代（数学、医学、建筑），马里帝国和曼萨·穆萨，中国宋朝；中世纪世界如何通过丝绸之路等贸易路线相互连接。
description.en: The medieval world beyond Europe: the Islamic Golden Age (maths, medicine, architecture), the Mali Empire and Mansa Musa, Song Dynasty China; how the medieval world was connected through trade routes like the Silk Road

evidence.zh: 至少列举伊斯兰黄金时代的两项成就（代数、医院、建筑）
evidence.en: Name at least two achievements of the Islamic Golden Age (algebra, hospitals, architecture)

evidence.zh: 描述曼萨·穆萨的身份及其名垂青史的原因。
evidence.en: Describe who Mansa Musa was and why he is remembered

evidence.zh: 解释丝绸之路如何通过贸易将中世纪世界相距遥远的地区联系起来。
evidence.en: Explain how the Silk Road connected distant parts of the medieval world through trade

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否向你介绍中世纪时期欧洲以外的重要文明，并解释丝绸之路是如何连接世界不同地区的？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you about important civilisations outside Europe during the Middle Ages and explain how the Silk Road connected different parts of the world?

description.zh: 古腾堡发明印刷机，以及威廉·卡克斯顿将印刷术带到英格兰；印刷书籍如何改变了一切；从中世纪到文艺复兴的过渡。
description.en: The invention of the printing press by Gutenberg and its arrival in England with William Caxton; how printed books changed everything; the transition from the Middle Ages to the Renaissance

evidence.zh: 解释印刷机的定义及其革命性意义。
evidence.en: Explain what the printing press was and why it was revolutionary

evidence.zh: 描述威廉·卡克斯顿将印刷术引入英格兰的作用
evidence.en: Describe William Caxton's role in bringing printing to England

evidence.zh: 能说出印刷术改变社会的一种方式（如扩大阅读群体、加速思想传播）。
evidence.en: Give at least one way printed books changed society (more people could read, ideas spread faster)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释为什么印刷机的发明是历史上最重要的时刻之一，以及它如何改变了世界？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain why the invention of the printing press was one of the most important moments in history and how it changed the world?

description.zh: 中世纪城镇的成长：集市、行会、商人阶层；城镇如何赢得自治特许状；从纯乡村生活向部分城市生活的转变。
description.en: The growth of medieval towns: markets, guilds, the merchant class; how towns won charters of self-governance; the shift from purely rural to partly urban life

evidence.zh: 描述中世纪城镇与村庄的区别（市场、城墙、行会、人口更多）
evidence.en: Describe how medieval towns were different from villages (markets, walls, guilds, more people)

evidence.zh: 解释行会的定义及其对手工业者的重要性
evidence.en: Explain what a guild was and why it mattered for tradespeople

evidence.zh: 描述城镇改变中世纪社会的一种方式（新商人阶层的出现、城镇居民获得更多自由）
evidence.en: Describe one way towns changed medieval society (new merchant class, more freedom for townspeople)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释中世纪城镇兴起的原因，以及市场和行会的兴起如何改变了人们的生活和工作方式？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain why medieval towns grew and how the rise of markets and guilds changed the way people lived and worked?

description.zh: 中世纪女性的生活：贵族女性管理庄园，农妇每天辛苦劳作，修女和女修道院长，以及像阿基坦的埃莉诺和圣女贞德这样的著名人物。
description.en: The lives of medieval women: noblewomen managing estates, peasant women's hard daily work, nuns and abbesses, notable figures like Eleanor of Aquitaine and Joan of Arc

evidence.zh: 描述贵族妇女、农民妇女和修女的不同生活。
evidence.en: Describe the different lives of noblewomen, peasant women, and nuns

evidence.zh: 能列举至少一位中世纪著名女性并概述其事迹。
evidence.en: Name at least one notable medieval woman and explain what she did

evidence.zh: 列举中世纪女性生活比现代女性受到更多限制的一个方面。
evidence.en: Explain one way women's lives in medieval times were more restricted than today

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否向你讲述中世纪女性的生活状况，并说出那位在中世纪历史上留下浓墨重彩的著名女性？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you about what life was like for women in medieval times and name a famous medieval woman who made her mark on history?

description.zh: 当你自己尝试过但仍然卡住时，要主动寻求帮助——知道什么时候该求助本身就是一种能力
description.en: Ask for help when you've had a go yourself and are still stuck — knowing when to ask is a skill in itself

evidence.zh: 掌握哈蒂的可见的学习理论
evidence.en: Hattie visible learning

evidence.zh: 自主学习
evidence.en: self-regulated learning research

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}已经尝试过某项任务但仍然卡住了，他会主动寻求帮助，而不是坐在那里感到沮丧或放弃吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} has tried something and is still stuck, do they come and ask for help rather than sitting frustrated or giving up?

description.zh: 完成一项任务后，回头看看自己做了什么，并问自己：这看起来对吗？
description.en: After finishing a task, look back at what you did and ask yourself: does this seem right?

evidence.zh: 作业完成后，能主动检查或回顾。
evidence.en: After finishing a piece of work, re-read or review it without being asked to

evidence.zh: 能通过检查，发现并改正作业中至少一处错误。
evidence.en: Spot and correct at least one error in their own work by checking back through it

evidence.zh: 描述自己的检查过程——例如：“我逐行重读，确保答案符合题目要求。”
evidence.en: Describe what they checked for — e.g. 'I re-read each line to make sure my answers matched the question'

assessmentPrompt.zh: 在{{name}}完成一项作业或活动后，他们是否会先自行检查一遍，确认无误后再表示自己已完成？
assessmentPrompt.en: After {{name}} finishes a piece of work or activity, do they look it over themselves to check it seems right before saying they're done?

description.zh: 当事情感觉很难时，继续尝试——犯错并再试一次，正是学习发生的方式
description.en: Keep trying when something feels hard — making mistakes and trying again is how learning happens

evidence.zh: 能持之以恒地完成困难任务，不轻易放弃，不请人代劳。
evidence.en: Keep working on a difficult task for a sustained period without giving up or asking someone else to do it

evidence.zh: 犯错后，能主动调整策略再次尝试，而非直接放弃说“我不会”。
evidence.en: After making a mistake, try again with a different approach rather than saying 'I can't do it'

evidence.zh: 积极谈论困难——例如说“这很难，但我正在进步”，而不是“我不擅长这个”。
evidence.en: Talk about difficulty positively — e.g. 'This is hard but I'm getting better' rather than 'I'm no good at this'

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}遇到一个特别难的谜题或活动，他们会不断尝试不同的方法，而不是马上放弃吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} finds a puzzle or activity really tricky, do they keep trying different ways rather than giving up straight away?

description.zh: 注意不理解的感觉——当遇到困惑时能够识别出来，而不是继续读或听下去
description.en: Notice the feeling of not understanding — recognise when something is confusing rather than reading or listening past it

evidence.zh: 理解监控研究
evidence.en: comprehension monitoring research

evidence.zh: 弗拉维尔元认知监控
evidence.en: Flavell metacognitive monitoring

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}在阅读或听讲时遇到不理解的地方，是否会主动察觉并提出来，而不是不懂装懂地继续下去？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} is reading or listening and something doesn't make sense, do they notice and say so — rather than carrying on as if they understood?

description.zh: 在开始任务之前，先做一个简单的计划：我需要做什么，应该先做什么？
description.en: Make a simple plan before starting a task: what do I need to do, and what should I do first?

evidence.zh: 任务开始前，能明确任务内容及执行顺序。
evidence.en: Before starting a task, describe what they need to do and what order to do it in

evidence.zh: 无需提示，能将复杂任务拆解为小步骤——如“我先读题，再画图”。
evidence.en: Break a larger task into smaller steps without being prompted — e.g. 'First I'll read the question, then I'll draw a diagram'

evidence.zh: 开始前先备齐所需材料或信息，而非开始后再停下来查找。
evidence.en: Gather the materials or information they need before beginning, rather than starting and then stopping to find things

assessmentPrompt.zh: 在{{name}}开始一项较大的任务之前——比如写一个故事或制作某样东西——他/她会先花点时间想一想自己要先做什么吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: Before {{name}} starts a bigger task — like writing a story or making something — do they take a moment to think about what they'll do first?

description.zh: 在开始新事物之前，停下来想一想：关于这个话题，我已经知道什么？
description.en: Before starting something new, stop and think: what do I already know about this topic?

evidence.zh: 先前知识激活研究
evidence.en: prior knowledge activation research

evidence.zh: 能判断新旧知识之间是否具有非人为的、实质性的联系
evidence.en: Ausubel meaningful learning

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}即将学习新知识时——比如科学课上的一个新主题或一种新的应用题——他们是否会先想想自己已经知道什么？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is about to learn something new — say a new topic in science or a new type of word problem — do they first think about what they already know?

description.zh: 寻找新知识和已有知识之间的联系——这个新知识和我以前学过的内容有什么关系？
description.en: Look for connections between new ideas and things you already know — how does this fit with what I've learned before?

evidence.zh: 精加工编码
evidence.en: elaborative encoding

evidence.zh: 掌握图式理论（巴特利特、鲁梅尔哈特）
evidence.en: schema theory (Bartlett, Rumelhart)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}学习新知识时，他们是否会说出“哦，这就像……”之类的话，并将其与已掌握的知识联系起来？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} learns something new, do they ever say things like 'oh, that's like...' and connect it to something they already knew?

description.zh: 在数字、词语、自然、声音或事件中发现规律和重复出现的结构，并利用它们来理解新信息
description.en: Spot patterns and recurring structures — in numbers, words, nature, sounds, or events — and use them to make sense of new information

evidence.zh: 无需提示，能自主发现数字、图形或事实中的规律。
evidence.en: Spot a pattern in a set of numbers, shapes, or facts without being told to look for one

evidence.zh: 运用发现的规律进行预测——例如：“下一个应该是16，因为每次都在翻倍。”
evidence.en: Use a pattern they noticed to make a prediction — e.g. 'The next one should be 16 because it's doubling each time'

evidence.zh: 解释发现的规律并说明理由
evidence.en: Explain the pattern they found and why they think it works

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}注意到某种规律时——比如数字规律、词尾规律，或反复出现的现象——他/她会运用这个规律来推断接下来会发生什么，或预测新的事物吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} notices a pattern — like a number pattern, a word ending, or something that keeps recurring — do they use it to figure out what comes next or predict something new?

description.zh: 学到新东西后，用自己的话讲出来——讲给自己、家人，甚至一个玩具听。
description.en: After learning something new, explain it in your own words — to yourself, a family member, or even a toy

evidence.zh: 能用自己的话向他人解释所学概念，而非简单复述老师所讲内容。
evidence.en: Explain a concept they've learned to someone else in their own words, not just repeating what the teacher said

evidence.zh: 在向同伴或兄弟姐妹讲解后，能识别出仅通过讲解才发现的自身理解盲区。
evidence.en: After teaching something to a friend or sibling, identify a gap in their own understanding that they only noticed through explaining

evidence.zh: 能通过模拟授课总结课程，并结合自身实例进行讲解。
evidence.en: Summarise a lesson by pretending to teach it back, using examples they made up themselves

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}在学校学了新知识后，能不能用自己的话复述给你听——而不是只照搬老师说的？
assessmentPrompt.en: After {{name}} learns something at school, can they explain it back to you in their own words — not just repeat what they were told?

description.zh: 当你的第一个方法不奏效时，试试别的方法——灵活调整策略是成为优秀学习者的重要部分。
description.en: When your first approach isn't working, try a different one — being flexible about strategies is part of being a good learner

evidence.zh: 遇到难题时，能尝试不同的解题策略，而非固守单一方法——如用画图替代列方程。
evidence.en: When stuck on a problem, try a completely different approach rather than repeating the same method — e.g. drawing a picture instead of writing equations

evidence.zh: 描述一次在任务执行过程中调整策略的经历，并说明新方法为何更有效。
evidence.en: Describe a time they changed strategy mid-task and explain why the new approach worked better

evidence.zh: 认可初始方案可能不可行，并愿意重新制定新方案。
evidence.en: Accept that their first idea might not work and show willingness to start over with a fresh plan

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}尝试用一种方法解决问题但行不通，他们是会换一种方法，还是只是重复同样的做法？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} tries one way to solve a problem and it isn't working, do they try a different approach rather than just repeating the same thing?

description.zh: 当你注意到一个规律反复出现时，把它描述成一条每次都适用的规则——然后检验这条规则在新情况下是否成立。
description.en: When you notice a pattern repeating, describe it as a rule that works every time — then test whether the rule holds in new cases

evidence.zh: 能用自己的语言表述所发现的规律或规则，如“任何数加0，结果不变”。
evidence.en: Describe a pattern or rule they've noticed in their own words — e.g. 'Every time you add 0 to a number, it stays the same'

evidence.zh: 检验学生能否将所述规则应用于此前未见过的新例子。
evidence.en: Test whether a rule they've described holds for new examples they haven't seen before

evidence.zh: 说明发现规律与证明规律普遍成立的区别
evidence.en: Explain the difference between noticing a pattern and proving it always works

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}发现了一个规律——比如语法规则或数字规律——他们能否将其概括为一般规则，然后检验它是否适用于新的例子？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} spots a pattern — like a grammar rule or a number pattern — can they describe it as a general rule and then check whether it works in new examples?

description.zh: 当你做错一件事时，去探究原因——你误解或忽略了什么？分析错误是最有效的学习方式之一。
description.en: When you get something wrong, investigate why — what did you misunderstand or overlook? Analysing errors is one of the most powerful ways to learn

evidence.zh: 错题分析研究
evidence.en: error analysis research

evidence.zh: 哈蒂反馈效应量
evidence.en: Hattie feedback effect size

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在考试或活动中做错题时，他们是否会去分析错误、弄清哪里出了问题，而不是直接跳过？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} gets something wrong on a test or activity, do they look at the mistake to understand what went wrong — rather than just moving on?

description.zh: 认识到在一个学科或情境中学到的技能或策略可以应用到完全不同的学科或情境中
description.en: Recognise when a skill or strategy learned in one subject or situation can be applied in a completely different one

evidence.zh: 掌握学习迁移的研究
evidence.en: transfer of learning research

evidence.zh: 佩金斯与所罗门迁移分类学
evidence.en: Perkins & Salomon transfer taxonomy

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}是否曾发现，自己在某一门学科中学到的某种方法——比如整理信息的方式——也能帮助自己学习完全不同的另一门学科？
assessmentPrompt.en: Has {{name}} ever spotted that something they learned in one subject — like a way of organising information — could help them in a completely different one?

description.zh: 不只知道某件事是真的，还要追问它为什么是真的、它是怎么运作的
description.en: Go beyond knowing *that* something is true — ask *why* it is true and *how* it works

evidence.zh: 对所学内容主动追问“为什么”或“这是如何运作的”，而非被动接受。
evidence.en: Ask 'why?' or 'how does that work?' about something they've been told, rather than just accepting it

evidence.zh: 说明规则或方法背后的原理——例如：“我们进位是因为13个一等于1个十和3个一。”
evidence.en: Explain the reason behind a rule or method — e.g. 'We carry the ten because 13 ones is the same as 1 ten and 3 ones'

evidence.zh: 能将新知识与已有知识建立联系，以体现更深层次的理解——例如：“哦，这就像我们……的时候一样。”
evidence.en: Show deeper understanding by connecting a new idea to something they already know — e.g. 'Oh, that's like when we...'

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}在学习一个事实时，是否经常问“但为什么呢？”——想要理解其背后的原因，而不是仅仅接受它？
assessmentPrompt.en: Does {{name}} often ask 'but why?' when they learn a fact — wanting to understand the reason behind it rather than just accepting it?

description.zh: 在开始学习任务前，有意识地选择一种策略；完成之后，诚实地评估这个策略是否真的有用。
description.en: Before starting a study task, choose a deliberate strategy; after finishing, evaluate honestly whether that strategy actually helped

evidence.zh: 在开始任务前，能说明计划采用的策略并阐述理由——例如：“我先画思维导图，因为要整理的内容很多。”
evidence.en: Before starting a task, name the strategy they plan to use and explain why — e.g. 'I'll make a mind map first because there's a lot to organise'

evidence.zh: 完成后，能客观评估所选策略的有效性，或判断是否有更优策略。
evidence.en: After finishing, honestly evaluate whether their chosen strategy helped or whether a different one would have been better

evidence.zh: 至少描述三种不同的学习策略，并解释每种策略最适合在什么情况下使用。
evidence.en: Describe at least three different learning strategies and explain when each works best

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}是否会谈论自己*打算如何*学习或练习某件事——并在之后反思这种方法是否有效？
assessmentPrompt.en: Does {{name}} ever talk about *how* they're going to study or practise something — and afterwards think about whether that approach worked?

description.zh: 完成一项学习后，反思过程：什么帮助最大，什么让你困惑，下次你会怎么做不同？
description.en: After completing a piece of learning, reflect on the process: what helped most, what was confusing, and what would you do differently next time?

evidence.zh: 掌握科尔布反思学习循环
evidence.en: Kolb reflective learning cycle

evidence.zh: 哈蒂与廷珀利反馈模型
evidence.en: Hattie & Timperley feedback model

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在学校完成一个项目或主题后，他们是否会反思学习的过程——不仅仅是结果好不好，还包括哪些方法有效、哪些无效？
assessmentPrompt.en: After {{name}} finishes a project or topic at school, do they reflect on how the learning went — not just whether the result was good, but what worked and what didn't?

description.zh: 审视自己对整个主题的理解——找出哪些地方掌握得扎实，哪些地方还不太确定，以及哪些地方还需要继续努力。
description.en: Survey your own understanding of a whole topic — identify where your knowledge is solid, where it is shaky, and what still needs work

evidence.zh: 元认知监控研究
evidence.en: metacognitive monitoring research

evidence.zh: 弗拉维尔元认知框架
evidence.en: Flavell metacognition framework

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你问{{name}}对某个整体主题的掌握程度，他们能否如实告诉你哪些部分他们觉得有把握，哪些部分还需要加强？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you ask {{name}} how well they understand a whole topic, can they tell you honestly which parts they feel confident on and which parts need more work?

description.zh: 设定一个具体的学习目标，用有计划的方法努力实现它，然后诚实地评估自己是否达成了目标，以及下次会做出哪些改变。
description.en: Set a specific learning goal, work towards it with a deliberate plan, then honestly assess whether you achieved it and what you would change

evidence.zh: 能为自己设定具体、可实现的学习目标——如“到周五掌握7的乘法口诀”，而非笼统的“提高数学成绩”。
evidence.en: Set a specific, achievable learning goal for themselves — e.g. 'By Friday I want to know all my 7-times tables' rather than just 'get better at maths'

evidence.zh: 能制定简单的目标达成计划，并坚持执行数日。
evidence.en: Make a simple plan for how to reach their goal and follow through on it over several days

evidence.zh: 截止日期后，如实评估目标是否达成，并说明下次如何改进。
evidence.en: After the deadline, honestly assess whether they achieved the goal and describe what they would do differently next time

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}是否会为自己设定一个具体的学习目标——比如“我想在这周末之前把乘法口诀练得更熟”——并诚实地评估自己是否达成了目标？
assessmentPrompt.en: Does {{name}} ever set themselves a specific learning goal — like 'I want to get better at times tables by the end of the week' — and then honestly judge whether they met it?

description.zh: 当有人制作或拥有某样东西时，他们可以把它卖掉；当有人想要某样东西时，他们可以买下来；介绍交换和交易的概念。
description.en: When someone makes or has something, they can sell it; when someone wants something, they can buy it; introduction to the concept of exchange and transactions

evidence.zh: 阐述买方与卖方的责任
evidence.en: Explain what a buyer does and what a seller does

evidence.zh: 能在模拟情境中与同伴完成简单的买卖交易。
evidence.en: Act out a simple buying and selling transaction with a partner

evidence.zh: 描述自己或家人从他人处购买物品的经历（如市场摊位、汽车后备箱集市、烘焙义卖）。
evidence.en: Describe a time they or a family member bought something from a person (market stall, car boot sale, bake sale)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}在学校义卖活动中摆摊，他们能否解释谁是买方和卖方，以及各自负责做什么？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} set up a stall at a school fair, could they explain who the buyers and sellers are and what each person does?

description.zh: 有些人制作东西（商品），有些人为别人做事（服务）；能在日常生活中识别这两种，并理解它们都有价值。
description.en: Some people make things (goods) and some people do things for others (services); recognising both in everyday life and understanding that both have value

evidence.zh: 能将图片分类为物品（可触摸的事物）与服务（他人为你做的事）
evidence.en: Sort a set of pictures into goods (things you can touch) and services (things people do for you)

evidence.zh: 能列举日常生活中三个物品和三项服务的实例
evidence.en: Give three examples of goods and three examples of services from their everyday life

evidence.zh: 说明创造物品和帮助他人都是有价值的工作类型。
evidence.en: Explain that both making things and helping people are valuable kinds of work

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否说出商店里购买的商品和理发之类的服务之间的区别，并各举几个例子？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you the difference between a product you buy in a shop and a service like getting a haircut, and give examples of each?

description.zh: 制作一个可以出售的产品——手工艺品、绘画、烘焙食品；什么让东西值得购买；为自己制作出别人想要的东西感到自豪。
description.en: The experience of creating a product to sell — a craft, a drawing, baked goods; what makes something worth buying; pride in making something others want

evidence.zh: 制作一件可出售的简单产品（手工艺品、绘画、烘焙食品）
evidence.en: Create a simple product (craft, drawing, baked item) that could be sold

evidence.zh: 能说明自己的产品好在哪里，从而说服他人购买。
evidence.en: Explain what makes their product good enough for someone to want to buy it

evidence.zh: 能对自己的产品合理定价并说明理由
evidence.en: Suggest a fair price for their product and give a reason

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}在家里做了一些东西——比如友谊手链或装饰饼干——他们能解释为什么有人会想买吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} made something at home — like friendship bracelets or decorated biscuits — could they explain why someone might want to buy them?

description.zh: 理解顾客就是购买你制作或提供的产品或服务的人；思考顾客想要什么和需要什么；理解企业是为人们服务的。
description.en: Understanding that a customer is someone who buys what you make or do; thinking about what customers want and need; the idea that businesses serve people

evidence.zh: 用自己的话给“客户”下定义
evidence.en: Define what a customer is in their own words

evidence.zh: 能针对影响顾客购买决策的因素（质量、价格、外观）提出建议
evidence.en: Suggest what a customer might look for when deciding whether to buy something (quality, price, looks nice)

evidence.zh: 解释为何需关注客户需求，而非仅关注自身设计意图。
evidence.en: Explain why it matters to think about what the customer wants, not just what you want to make

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}打算在学校活动上卖柠檬水，他们能不能想一想，怎样才能让人们愿意买他们的柠檬水，而不是别人的？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} was planning to sell lemonade at a school event, could they think about what would make people want to buy their lemonade rather than someone else's?

description.zh: 在生意中做到顾客服务、公平和诚实；对顾客信守承诺；为什么值得信赖对回头客和好名声很重要
description.en: Customer service, fairness, and honesty in business; keeping promises to customers; why being trustworthy matters for repeat business and reputation

evidence.zh: 阐明如实介绍所售商品的重要性
evidence.en: Explain why being honest about what you're selling matters

evidence.zh: 描述优质客户服务的表现（礼貌、乐于助人、信守承诺）
evidence.en: Describe what good customer service looks like (being polite, helpful, keeping promises)

evidence.zh: 能举例说明不公正或不诚实行为对企业造成的危害。
evidence.en: Give an example of how being unfair or dishonest could hurt a business

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}把东西卖给朋友，结果第二天就坏了，他们能否理解为什么重要的是去弥补，而不是置之不理？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} sold something to a friend and it broke the next day, would they understand why it's important to make it right rather than ignore it?

description.zh: 做东西需要花钱（成本/费用）；卖东西可以赚钱（收入）；如果收入大于成本，就是盈利；如果成本大于收入，就是亏损。
description.en: It costs money to make things (costs/expenses); you earn money by selling them (revenue); if revenue is more than costs, that's profit; if costs are more, that's a loss

evidence.zh: 能结合简单例子说明成本、收入和利润的含义
evidence.en: Explain what costs, revenue, and profit mean using a simple example

evidence.zh: 能在具体情境中计算利润（如：成本3英镑，蛋糕售价8英镑，利润为5英镑）。
evidence.en: Calculate profit from a given scenario (e.g. spent £3 on ingredients, sold cakes for £8, profit = £5)

evidence.zh: 解释当成本超过收入时会发生什么（即亏损）。
evidence.en: Explain what happens if costs are higher than revenue (you make a loss)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}花了4英镑买柠檬水摊的材料，又靠卖柠檬水赚了10英镑，他们能说出自己赚了多少利润吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} spent £4 on supplies for a lemonade stand and earned £10 selling lemonade, could they tell you how much profit they made?

description.zh: 商业点子从哪里来；发现日常问题并思考解决方案；发明新事物与改进现有事物的区别
description.en: Where business ideas come from; spotting everyday problems and thinking of solutions; the difference between inventing something new and improving something that exists

evidence.zh: 能发现生活中的简单问题，并提出能解决该问题的产品或服务。
evidence.en: Identify a simple everyday problem and suggest a product or service that could solve it

evidence.zh: 解释发明（创造新事物）与创新（改进现有事物）的区别
evidence.en: Explain the difference between an invention (something new) and an innovation (making something better)

evidence.zh: 描述一位真实企业家的创业灵感来源
evidence.en: Describe where one real entrepreneur got their business idea from

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你让{{name}}想一个在学校或家里遇到的问题，并思考能否通过制作或出售某样东西来解决，他能想出一个主意吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you asked {{name}} to think of a problem at school or home that they could solve by making or selling something, could they come up with an idea?

description.zh: 不是每个商业想法都能成功；企业家会尝试、失败、学习，然后再尝试；迭代和韧性是核心创业技能；著名的从失败到成功的故事
description.en: Not every business idea works; entrepreneurs try, fail, learn, and try again; iteration and resilience as core entrepreneurial skills; famous failure-to-success stories

evidence.zh: 能举例说明一位先失败后成功的企业家。
evidence.en: Give an example of a famous entrepreneur who failed before succeeding

evidence.zh: 若首次创业想法未成功，能说明自己会做出哪些不同的调整。
evidence.en: Explain what they would do differently if a business idea didn't work the first time

evidence.zh: 说明为何失败后坚持尝试优于放弃
evidence.en: Describe why failing and trying again is better than giving up

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}第一次尝试某个项目或创业想法没有成功，他们会把它看作一个改进的机会，而不是放弃的理由吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}}'s first attempt at a project or business idea didn't work out, would they see it as a chance to improve rather than a reason to give up?

description.zh: 在开始做生意之前，制定一个简单的计划：我要做什么或提供什么服务？谁会来买？我需要什么？成本是多少？我打算卖多少钱？
description.en: Before starting a business, making a simple plan: what will I make or do, who will buy it, what do I need, how much will it cost, and what price will I charge?

evidence.zh: 能编写或绘制简单的商业计划，包括：产品、客户、所需材料及价格
evidence.en: Write or draw a simple business plan covering: product, customer, materials needed, and price

evidence.zh: 至少说出开展销售前必备的三样东西
evidence.en: Identify at least three things they would need before they could start selling

evidence.zh: 解释为什么提前规划优于不假思索地开始
evidence.en: Explain why planning ahead is better than just starting without thinking

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}想在学校集市上做点小生意，他们能不能写一份简单的计划，说明打算卖什么、需要准备什么、以及打算怎么定价？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} wanted to run a small business at a school fair, could they write a simple plan covering what they'd sell, what they'd need, and what they'd charge?

description.zh: 人们如何知道你卖的东西；招牌、海报、社交媒体、口口相传；如何说服别人；广告和促销的基础知识
description.en: How people find out about what you're selling; signs, posters, social media, word of mouth; being persuasive; the basics of advertising and promotion

evidence.zh: 为产品或服务设计简单的海报或广告。
evidence.en: Design a simple poster or advert for a product or service

evidence.zh: 至少列举三种向他人推销所售商品的方法
evidence.en: Name at least three ways to let people know about something you're selling

evidence.zh: 解释为什么朗朗上口的名称或醒目的设计有助于提升销量
evidence.en: Explain why a catchy name or eye-catching design helps sell more

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}想宣传洗车活动或烘焙义卖，他们能设计出一张吸引人来参加的海报吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} wanted to advertise a car wash or bake sale, could they design a poster that would make people want to come?

description.zh: 大多数企业需要不止一个人；一起工作、分工合作、发挥不同人的长处；团队合作在商业中的价值。
description.en: Most businesses need more than one person; working together, dividing tasks, and using different people's strengths; the value of teamwork in business

evidence.zh: 能说明团队商业项目中的分工方式（一人负责生产、一人负责销售、一人负责设计）。
evidence.en: Describe how they would divide tasks in a team business project (one person makes, one sells, one designs)

evidence.zh: 阐述发挥个体优势对促进企业发展的作用
evidence.en: Explain why using people's different strengths makes a business better

evidence.zh: 能举例说明团队合作不佳可能导致的问题。
evidence.en: Give an example of a problem that could happen if a team doesn't work well together

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}和朋友们一起在集市上摆摊，他们能否提出如何分工，让每个人都能发挥自己的优势？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} was working with friends to run a stall at a fair, could they suggest how to divide up the jobs so everyone plays to their strengths?

description.zh: 诚实守信、公平待人、善待员工、不破坏环境；什么是‘好’企业；企业是否应该不仅仅关心利润
description.en: Being honest, being fair, treating workers well, not harming the environment; what makes a 'good' business; whether businesses should care about more than profit

evidence.zh: 至少列举两种企业合乎道德的做法（公平薪酬、诚信广告、对环境负责）。
evidence.en: Name at least two things that make a business ethical (fair wages, honest advertising, environmentally responsible)

evidence.zh: 解释唯利是图的企业可能带来问题的原因
evidence.en: Explain why a business that only cares about profit might cause problems

evidence.zh: 描述企业主遭遇道德困境的场景，并提出应对建议。
evidence.en: Describe a situation where a business owner faces an ethical choice and suggest what they should do

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}听说一家公司为了赚取更高利润而给工人支付很低的工资，他/她能否解释为什么这不公平，并提出更好的做法？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} heard about a company paying its workers very little to make bigger profits, could they explain why that's unfair and suggest a better approach?

description.zh: 有说服力地向他人展示商业创意；解释它的优点以及为什么人们应该支持它；在公开演讲中建立自信。
description.en: Presenting a business idea to others convincingly; explaining what makes it good and why people should support it; building confidence in public speaking about ideas

evidence.zh: 针对一个商业创意进行1-2分钟的路演，需包含：创意内容、目标受众及核心优势。
evidence.en: Deliver a 1-2 minute pitch for a business idea covering: what it is, who it helps, and why it's good

evidence.zh: 能针对自己的观点回应听众至少两个提问
evidence.en: Answer at least two questions about their idea from an audience

evidence.zh: 阐明清晰表达想法对获得支持的重要性
evidence.en: Explain why being able to explain your idea clearly matters for getting support

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果让{{name}}站在全班同学面前，用两分钟时间阐述一个商业创意，他/她能自信且有说服力地完成吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} had to stand up in front of the class and explain a business idea in two minutes, could they do it confidently and persuasively?

description.zh: 从小创业的真实企业家的故事：米凯拉·乌尔默（Me & the Bees）、莫西亚·布里奇斯（Mo's Bows）、科里·涅韦斯（Mr. Cory's Cookies）；是什么让一个人成为企业家
description.en: Stories of real entrepreneurs who started young: Mikaila Ulmer (Me & the Bees), Moziah Bridges (Mo's Bows), Cory Nieves (Mr. Cory's Cookies); what makes someone an entrepreneur

evidence.zh: 能讲述至少一位从小创业的真实企业家的故事。
evidence.en: Retell the story of at least one real entrepreneur who started as a child

evidence.zh: 能说出该企业家成功的三个特质（创造力、坚持、热情）
evidence.en: Identify three qualities that helped that entrepreneur succeed (creativity, persistence, passion)

evidence.zh: 能用自己的话解释“创业者”的含义
evidence.en: Explain what the word 'entrepreneur' means in their own words

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否向你介绍一位从小创业的真实人物，并说明哪些品质帮助他们取得了成功？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you about a real person who started a business as a kid and explain what qualities helped them succeed?

description.zh: 当小生意成长时会发生什么；生产更多产品、雇佣更多人、接触更多顾客；扩大规模的挑战和机会
description.en: What happens when a small business grows; making more products, hiring people, reaching more customers; the challenges and opportunities of scaling

evidence.zh: 描述企业“扩大规模”的含义
evidence.en: Describe what 'scaling up' means for a business

evidence.zh: 至少能列举企业扩张面临的两大挑战（资金需求增加、人员需求增加、物资需求增加）。
evidence.en: Identify at least two challenges of growing a business (need more money, more people, more materials)

evidence.zh: 逐步解释柠檬水摊如何发展成更大的企业。
evidence.en: Explain how a lemonade stand could grow into a bigger business step by step

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释一下，如果他们学校义卖的小生意变得非常火爆，有更多人想从他们那里购买，那么需要做出哪些改变？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain what would need to change if their small school-fair business became so popular that lots more people wanted to buy from them?

description.zh: 用商业技能帮助他人或解决社会和环境问题；既能赚钱又能带来改变；社会企业的例子
description.en: Using business skills to help others or solve social and environmental problems; making money AND making a difference; examples of social enterprises

evidence.zh: 用自己的话解释什么是社会企业（即造福人类或地球的企业）
evidence.en: Explain what a social enterprise is in their own words (a business that helps people or the planet)

evidence.zh: 能举例说明一个真实的社会企业或慈善商店。
evidence.en: Give an example of a real social enterprise or charity shop

evidence.zh: 能提出一个服务于学校或社区的社会企业创意
evidence.en: Suggest a social enterprise idea that could help their school or community

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否想出一个既有利可图又能造福人类或环境的商业创意？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} come up with an idea for a business that both makes money and helps people or the environment?

description.zh: 产品在到达顾客手中之前来自哪里；原材料、制造、运输和销售；一个产品从开始到结束的旅程
description.en: Where products come from before they reach the customer; raw materials, making, transporting, and selling; the journey of a product from start to finish

evidence.zh: 追溯常见商品（如巧克力棒）从原材料到上架的流通过程
evidence.en: Trace the journey of a familiar product (e.g. chocolate bar) from raw material to shop shelf

evidence.zh: 能识别供应链中的至少三个环节
evidence.en: Identify at least three stages in a supply chain

evidence.zh: 解释供应链过长导致产品价格上涨的原因
evidence.en: Explain why a long supply chain can make a product more expensive

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你问{{name}}，一块巧克力棒是如何从可可农场来到商店货架上的，他/她能描述出这一过程的主要步骤吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you asked {{name}} how a chocolate bar gets from a cocoa farm to a shop shelf, could they describe the main steps in the journey?

description.zh: 买卖是怎么进行的：价格、付钱、找零；在商店和市场里基本的交易过程
description.en: How buying and selling works: prices, paying for items, receiving change; the basic transaction process in shops and markets

evidence.zh: 能说出商店购物的步骤（挑选、付款、找零）
evidence.en: Explain what happens when you buy something in a shop (choose, pay, get change)

evidence.zh: 能读懂价签并判断钱是否够买该商品
evidence.en: Read a price label and say whether they have enough money to buy the item

evidence.zh: 能在真实或模拟的购物情境中，使用硬币完成简单交易。
evidence.en: Act out a simple buying scenario using real or play coins

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}有一枚2英镑的硬币，想买一份80便士的零食，他们能估算出大概会找回多少零钱吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} had a £2 coin and wanted to buy a snack for 80p, could they work out roughly how much change they'd get back?

description.zh: 认识常见的硬币和纸币，知道它们的价值，并理解不同的组合可以凑成相同的金额。
description.en: Recognising common coins and notes, knowing their values, and understanding that different combinations can make the same amount

evidence.zh: 按面值对一组混合硬币进行分类。
evidence.en: Sort a handful of mixed coins into groups by value

evidence.zh: 能识别常见硬币和纸币的面值。
evidence.en: State the value of common coins and notes when shown them

evidence.zh: 用两种不同硬币组合表示同一金额。
evidence.en: Find two different ways to make the same amount using different coins

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果把一罐硬币倒出来，{{name}}能不能把它们分类，并说出每种硬币值多少钱？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you tipped out a jar of coins, could {{name}} sort them and tell you how much each type is worth?

description.zh: 人们从事的各种工作；人们通过工作赚钱；工作如何帮助社区；将个人兴趣与可能的工作联系起来
description.en: Different kinds of work people do; that people earn money by working; how jobs help the community; linking personal interests to possible jobs

evidence.zh: 能列举至少五种职业并说明其主要工作内容。
evidence.en: Name at least five different jobs and describe what each person does

evidence.zh: 能说出人们通过工作获得报酬。
evidence.en: Explain that people get paid money for the work they do

evidence.zh: 能将个人兴趣与职业选择建立联系（如“我喜欢动物，所以我可以成为兽医”）。
evidence.en: Connect a personal interest to a job (e.g. 'I like animals so I could be a vet')

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否向你介绍社区中人们从事的不同职业，并说明人们通过工作获得报酬？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} tell you about different jobs people do in your community and explain that people get paid for their work?

description.zh: 把金钱保管好；不弄丢硬币或纸币；明白金钱有真实价值，应该小心对待；基本的金钱责任感
description.en: Keeping money safe; not losing coins or notes; understanding that money has real value and should be treated carefully; basic money responsibility

evidence.zh: 能说出至少两种保管钱的方法（如放钱包、钱夹、储蓄罐，或请大人代管）。
evidence.en: Describe at least two ways to keep money safe (purse, wallet, money box, giving to a grown-up)

evidence.zh: 阐释亏损的影响机制
evidence.en: Explain why it matters if you lose money

evidence.zh: 爱护人民币，不乱扔乱放。
evidence.en: Show that they treat real coins and notes carefully rather than leaving them lying around

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你给{{name}}一些硬币，让他自己在商店里保管，他能管好自己的钱并记住放在哪里吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you gave {{name}} some coins to look after at a shop, would they keep them safe and know where they put them?

description.zh: 我们需要的东西（食物、住所、衣服）和我们想要的东西（玩具、零食）之间的区别；因为钱是有限的，我们有时必须做出选择。
description.en: The difference between things we need (food, shelter, clothing) and things we want (toys, treats); that we sometimes have to choose because money is limited

evidence.zh: 能区分“需要”和“想要”，并对一组图片进行分类并说明理由。
evidence.en: Sort a set of pictures into 'need' and 'want' categories and explain their choices

evidence.zh: 能举例说明需要与想要的区别。
evidence.en: Give an example of something everyone needs and something that is a want

evidence.zh: 解释家庭为何可能选择先购买必需品而非想要品
evidence.en: Explain why a family might choose to buy a need before a want

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你给{{name}}看一张冬季外套、一个玩具机器人和一条面包的图片，他们能告诉你哪些是必需品、哪个是想要的东西吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you showed {{name}} pictures of a winter coat, a toy robot, and a loaf of bread, could they tell you which ones are needs and which is a want?

description.zh: 人们为什么要存钱；存钱罐和储蓄罐；设定一个储蓄目标；现在不花意味着以后有更多
description.en: Why people save money; piggy banks and saving jars; setting a savings goal; the idea that not spending now means having more later

evidence.zh: 解释人们储蓄而非即时消费的原因。
evidence.en: Explain why someone might save money instead of spending it straight away

evidence.zh: 描述一个可设定的储蓄目标及实现该目标的努力方式。
evidence.en: Describe a savings goal they could set and how they would work towards it

evidence.zh: 能用自己的话解释延迟满足的含义（即为获得更好的结果而等待）
evidence.en: Tell you what delayed gratification means in their own words (waiting to get something better)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}收到了一些生日礼金，他们能否解释为什么把一部分存起来而不是一次性全部花掉可能是明智的？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} received some birthday money, could they explain why it might be smart to save some of it rather than spending it all at once?

description.zh: 了解钱是什么以及我们为什么要用钱；钱可以用来交换商品和服务；从物物交换到硬币再到数字支付的简要历史
description.en: What money is and why we use it; that money is exchanged for goods and services; brief history from barter to coins to digital payments

evidence.zh: 说明人们用钱购买自己需要或想要的东西。
evidence.en: Explain that people use money to pay for things they need or want

evidence.zh: 能举例说明货币出现前的物物交换方式。
evidence.en: Give an example of how buying worked before money existed (swapping or bartering)

evidence.zh: 至少能说出两种货币形式（硬币、纸币、银行卡、手机支付）。
evidence.en: Name at least two forms money can take (coins, notes, card, phone payment)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你问{{name}}为什么人们使用货币而不是直接以物易物，他能否给出一个合理的解释？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you asked {{name}} why people use money instead of just swapping things, could they give you a sensible answer?

description.zh: 广告如何试图影响我们购买什么；做一个有判断力的消费者；理解“物有所值”；情感消费与理性消费的区别。
description.en: How advertising tries to influence what we buy; being a critical consumer; understanding 'value for money'; the difference between emotional and rational spending

evidence.zh: 能在真实广告中识别至少两种说服技巧（鲜艳色彩、名人代言、特别优惠）
evidence.en: Spot at least two persuasion techniques in a real advert (bright colours, celebrity, special offer)

evidence.zh: 解释“性价比”的含义，并比较两款价格不同的同类产品。
evidence.en: Explain what 'value for money' means and compare two similar products at different prices

evidence.zh: 描述一次广告促使他们想要某样并非真正需要的东西的经历
evidence.en: Describe a time when advertising made them want something they didn't really need

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}看到玩具或游戏的广告时，能否意识到广告是在试图激发他们的购买欲望？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} sees an advert for a toy or game, can they recognise that the advert is trying to make them want to buy it?

description.zh: 银行是做什么的，人们为什么使用银行；银行账户是存钱的安全地方；存在银行里的钱可以获得利息；儿童储蓄账户
description.en: What banks do and why people use them; bank accounts as safe places for money; that savings in a bank can earn interest; children's savings accounts

evidence.zh: 能用简单的语言解释银行的功能（如保管资金、储蓄）。
evidence.en: Explain what a bank does in simple terms (keeps money safe, lets you save)

evidence.zh: 理解利息的含义（即银行因你存款而额外支付给你的报酬）
evidence.en: Describe what interest means (the bank pays you a little extra for keeping money there)

evidence.zh: 说出将现金全部留在家中不如存入银行账户安全的一个原因。
evidence.en: Name one reason a bank account is safer than keeping all your money at home

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释银行的功能，以及为什么人们把钱存入银行而不是全部放在家里？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain what a bank does and why people put their money there instead of keeping it all at home?

description.zh: 什么是预算；计划如何花掉固定数额的零花钱；在你想要买的不同东西之间做出取舍
description.en: What a budget is; planning how to spend a fixed amount of pocket money or allowance; making trade-offs between different things you want to buy

evidence.zh: 能为10英镑制定简单的消费计划，说明购买物品及剩余金额。
evidence.en: Create a simple spending plan for £10 showing what they would buy and how much is left

evidence.zh: 解释预算的概念及其对支出规划的帮助。
evidence.en: Explain what a budget is and why it helps to plan spending

evidence.zh: 识别权衡取舍（一种用途的选择意味着资源不足以用于另一用途）
evidence.en: Identify a trade-off (choosing one thing means not having enough for another)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}有10英镑可以在学校游园会上花，他们能不能提前做好计划，让这笔钱花得更久？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} had £10 to spend at a school fair, could they plan in advance what to spend it on so the money lasts?

description.zh: 儿童和成人赚钱的方式；工作、技能与报酬之间的联系；通常越辛苦或技能要求越高的工作，报酬也越高。
description.en: Ways that children and adults earn money; the connection between work, skills and pay; that harder or more skilled work often pays more

evidence.zh: 至少列举三种不同的赚钱方式
evidence.en: Name at least three different ways people can earn money

evidence.zh: 解释医生收入可能高于售货员的原因（培训、技能、责任）。
evidence.en: Explain why a doctor might earn more than a shop assistant (training, skills, responsibility)

evidence.zh: 能列举孩子获取收入的一种途径（如做家务、洗车、售卖手工艺品）
evidence.en: Describe a way a child could earn money (chores, car wash, selling crafts)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释为什么某些工作的报酬高于其他工作，并描述一种他/她自己可能赚钱的方式？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain why some jobs pay more than others and describe a way they might earn some money themselves?

description.zh: 了解产品来自哪里、由谁制造；世界各地的人们生产我们购买的东西；工人应获得公平报酬；作为消费者做出有道德的选择
description.en: Where products come from and who makes them; that people around the world produce what we buy; fair pay for workers; making ethical choices as consumers

evidence.zh: 能说明所购物品由真实的人制造，有时产自其他国家。
evidence.en: Explain that the things we buy are made by real people, sometimes in other countries

evidence.zh: 能用自己的话解释“公平贸易”的含义（即工人获得公平报酬）
evidence.en: Describe what 'fair trade' means in simple terms (workers get paid fairly)

evidence.zh: 能举例说明消费者可作出的友善选择（如购买公平贸易巧克力、选择包装较少的产品）
evidence.en: Give an example of a kind choice a shopper could make (buying fair trade chocolate, choosing less packaging)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}在巧克力棒上看到公平贸易标志，他们能解释它的含义和重要性吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} saw a Fairtrade logo on a chocolate bar, could they explain what it means and why it matters?

description.zh: 计算购物后的找零；自信地处理英镑和便士的混合运算；解决涉及加法和减法的实际金钱问题
description.en: Calculating change from a purchase; working confidently with pounds and pence together; solving practical money problems involving addition and subtraction

evidence.zh: 计算用5英镑购买以镑和便士计价的物品后的找零
evidence.en: Calculate the change from £5 when buying items costing pounds and pence

evidence.zh: 能计算两三件商品的总价
evidence.en: Add two or three prices together to find a total cost

evidence.zh: 能在角色扮演情境中正确完成找零操作
evidence.en: Check whether they have been given the correct change in a role-play scenario

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}买了一本2.75英镑的漫画书，并付了一张5英镑的纸币，他们能算出应该找回2.25英镑吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} bought a comic for £2.75 and paid with a £5 note, could they work out they should get £2.25 back?

description.zh: 不同的支付方式：现金、借记卡、非接触式支付、在线支付、移动支付；数字支付仍然使用真实的钱；保护支付信息的安全
description.en: Different ways to pay: cash, debit cards, contactless, online payments, mobile payments; that digital payments still use real money; keeping payment details safe

evidence.zh: 至少列举四种不同的支付方式。
evidence.en: Name at least four different ways people can pay for things

evidence.zh: 能说明拍卡或手机支付同样会从银行账户中扣除真实资金
evidence.en: Explain that tapping a card or phone still spends real money from a bank account

evidence.zh: 能说出一个妥善保管银行卡号和密码的理由
evidence.en: Give one reason why you should keep card numbers and passwords private

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}是否明白，当你刷卡或用手机支付时，即使看不到硬币易手，真实的钱也已经从你的银行账户里扣走了？
assessmentPrompt.en: Does {{name}} understand that when you tap a card or use a phone to pay, real money leaves your bank account even though you can't see coins changing hands?

description.zh: 借钱是什么意思；贷款必须连本带利还清；什么是信用；为什么债务太多会有风险；负责任地借钱
description.en: What borrowing money means; that loans must be repaid with interest; what credit is; why too much debt can be risky; responsible borrowing

evidence.zh: 解释贷款的含义，并说明借款需偿还本金并支付额外利息（利息）。
evidence.en: Explain what a loan is and that borrowed money must be paid back with extra (interest)

evidence.zh: 能举例说明何时借贷是明智的（如买房），何时是有风险的（如购买负担不起的奢侈品）。
evidence.en: Give an example of when borrowing might be sensible (buying a house) versus risky (buying luxuries you can't afford)

evidence.zh: 描述过度借贷且无力偿还的后果
evidence.en: Describe what happens if someone borrows too much money and can't repay it

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释为什么借钱的成本会高于借款金额，以及为什么这一点很重要？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain why borrowing money costs more than the amount you borrow, and why that matters?

description.zh: 设定较长期的财务目标；规划和优先安排支出；定期储蓄如何随时间累积；用钱时提前思考的价值
description.en: Setting longer-term financial goals; planning and prioritising spending; how saving regularly adds up over time; the value of thinking ahead with money

evidence.zh: 能够设定现实的储蓄目标，并计算每周存固定金额需要多长时间才能实现。
evidence.en: Set a realistic savings goal and calculate how long it would take saving a fixed amount each week

evidence.zh: 能为特定目标（如生日聚会、学校旅行、购买礼物）制定简单的理财计划
evidence.en: Create a simple financial plan for a specific purpose (birthday party, school trip, gift)

evidence.zh: 说明为什么计划开支比有多少花多少更好。
evidence.en: Explain why planning ahead with money is better than spending everything as it comes in

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}想存钱买一个价值30英镑的物品，他们能否制定出一个切实可行的计划来估算需要多长时间？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} wanted to save up for something costing £30, could they work out a realistic plan for how long it would take?

description.zh: 为什么国家之间要进行贸易；进口和出口；商品如何在全球流动；不同国家使用不同的货币
description.en: Why countries trade with each other; imports and exports; how goods travel around the world; that different countries use different currencies

evidence.zh: 解释国家为何从其他国家购买商品（它们无法自给自足生产所有东西）
evidence.en: Explain why countries buy goods from other countries (they can't make everything themselves)

evidence.zh: 能举例说明本国的进口和出口产品
evidence.en: Give examples of imported and exported products from their own country

evidence.zh: 能说出不同国家使用不同货币，旅行时需兑换货币。
evidence.en: Explain that different countries use different currencies and you need to exchange money when travelling

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}看了你厨房里物品上的标签，他们能解释为什么这么多东西来自不同国家吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} looked at the labels on items in your kitchen, could they explain why so many things come from different countries?

description.zh: 什么是经济；生产者和消费者；供给与需求；价格为什么会变化；市场如何运行的基础知识
description.en: What an economy is; producers and consumers; supply and demand; why prices change; the basics of how markets work

evidence.zh: 能结合简单例子（如炎热天气里的冰淇淋）解释“供求关系”的含义。
evidence.en: Explain what 'supply and demand' means using a simple example (ice cream on a hot day)

evidence.zh: 描述生产者与消费者的区别
evidence.en: Describe the difference between a producer and a consumer

evidence.zh: 能说出某物品价格上涨或下跌的一个原因
evidence.en: Give a reason why the price of something might go up or down

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释为什么夏天海滩上的冰淇淋可能比冬天超市里的冰淇淋贵？
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain why ice cream might cost more at the beach in summer than at a supermarket in winter?

description.zh: 识别金融诈骗和骗局；钓鱼邮件和虚假网站；在网上保护个人和财务信息；‘如果好得不像真的，那很可能就是假的’
description.en: Recognising financial scams and tricks; phishing emails and fake websites; protecting personal and financial information online; 'if it seems too good to be true, it probably is'

evidence.zh: 至少能识别两种诈骗警示信号（索要个人信息、好得令人难以置信的优惠、制造紧迫感）
evidence.en: Identify at least two warning signs of a scam (asking for personal details, too-good-to-be-true offers, urgency)

evidence.zh: 解释为何绝不能在网上分享密码或银行信息
evidence.en: Explain why you should never share passwords or bank details online

evidence.zh: 能说出收到可疑信息或邮件时的应对方法（不点击，告知成年人）
evidence.en: Describe what to do if they receive a suspicious message or email (don't click, tell an adult)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}收到一条消息，说他们中奖了，只需填写个人信息就能领奖，他们能识别出这很可能是诈骗吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} received a message saying they'd won a prize and just needed to enter their details, would they know it's probably a scam?

description.zh: 什么是税收，人们为什么要交税；税收如何为学校、医院、道路和紧急服务提供资金；政府决定如何使用税收。
description.en: What taxes are and why people pay them; how taxes fund schools, hospitals, roads, and emergency services; that governments decide how to spend tax money

evidence.zh: 解释税收的概念，并说明大多数有工作的成年人需要纳税。
evidence.en: Explain what tax is and that most working adults pay it

evidence.zh: 能列举至少三项税收用途（如学校、医院、道路、警察、消防）。
evidence.en: Name at least three things that taxes pay for (schools, hospitals, roads, police, fire service)

evidence.zh: 解释税收的必要性（取之于民，用之于民）
evidence.en: Describe why taxes are needed (everyone chips in so everyone benefits)

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}能否解释一下，用于学校和医院等公共设施的资金从哪里来？这些设施是大家都要使用的。
assessmentPrompt.en: Could {{name}} explain where the money comes from to pay for things like schools and hospitals that everyone uses?

description.zh: 使用实物或图画解决10以内的加减法应用题
description.en: Solve addition and subtraction word problems within 10 using objects or drawings

evidence.zh: 借助计数器解决“6个苹果吃掉2个还剩几个”的问题
evidence.en: Solve 'There are 6 apples, 2 are eaten, how many left?' using counters

evidence.zh: 解决“增加”和“减少”结果未知的问题
