assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} looks at a set of railway tracks or a window frame, can they point to which lines are parallel (never crossing) and which are perpendicular (meeting at a right angle)?

description.zh: 认识直角；知道两个直角组成半圈，三个直角组成四分之三圈，四个直角组成一整圈
description.en: Identify right angles; recognise that two right angles make a half-turn, three make three-quarters, and four make a complete turn

evidence.zh: 能借助直角测量工具，识别图形及生活环境中的直角。
evidence.en: Use a right-angle checker to identify right angles in shapes and the environment

evidence.zh: 能将角分类为直角、锐角或钝角。
evidence.en: Classify angles as right angles, less than a right angle, or greater than a right angle

evidence.zh: 说明4个直角构成一个周角（360°）。
evidence.en: Explain that 4 right angles make a full turn (360°)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}看着纸的一个角，他们能告诉你那是直角——并且转一整圈需要四个直角吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} looks at the corner of a piece of paper, can they tell you that's a right angle — and that spinning all the way round takes four right angles?

description.zh: 将角理解为图形的一种属性或旋转的描述
description.en: Recognise angles as a property of shape or a description of a turn

evidence.zh: 识别二维图形顶点处的角
evidence.en: Identify angles at the corners of 2-D shapes

evidence.zh: 能用定量的语言描述旋转（如四分之一圈、半圈）。
evidence.en: Describe a turn (e.g. quarter turn, half turn) in terms of the angle made

evidence.zh: 理解角的定义：角是度量相交于一点的两条射线之间旋转量的量。
evidence.en: Explain that an angle measures the amount of turn between two lines meeting at a point

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你让{{name}}指出书本的角或门框上的角，他们能找到吗——并能解释推开门也是一种旋转（角）吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you ask {{name}} to point to an angle on the corner of a book or door frame, can they find it — and explain that swinging a door open is also a kind of turn (angle)?

description.zh: 识别不同方向摆放的二维图形的对称轴；认识轴对称图形并画出对称轴
description.en: Identify lines of symmetry in 2-D shapes presented in different orientations; recognise line-symmetric figures and draw lines of symmetry

evidence.zh: 找出长方形、正方形和等边三角形的所有对称轴
evidence.en: Find all lines of symmetry in a rectangle, square, and equilateral triangle

evidence.zh: 判断给定图形旋转后是否具有对称轴
evidence.en: Determine whether a given shape has a line of symmetry when rotated

evidence.zh: 在一组图形中识别出恰好有一条对称轴的图形
evidence.en: Identify which shapes in a set have exactly one line of symmetry

evidence.zh: 确定正六边形的对称轴数量
evidence.en: Determine how many lines of symmetry a regular hexagon has

evidence.zh: 能画出给定图形的所有对称轴
evidence.en: Draw all lines of symmetry for a given figure

evidence.zh: 能在给定图形中识别出非轴对称图形。
evidence.en: Identify which figures from a set are not line-symmetric

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}一张蝴蝶或星形的图片，他们能否画出恰好将其对折、使两边完全重合的折线？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} is given a picture of a butterfly or a star shape, can they draw the line (or lines) where you could fold it exactly in half so both sides match?

description.zh: 在坐标网格上标出指定的点，并画出边来组成给定的多边形。
description.en: Plot specified points on a coordinate grid and draw sides to complete a given polygon

evidence.en: Plot points (1,1), (1,4), (5,4), (5,1) and join to make a rectangle

evidence.zh: 给定正方形三个顶点，画出第四个顶点。
evidence.en: Given three vertices of a square, plot the fourth vertex

evidence.zh: 在给定坐标处标出第三个顶点并画出各边，补全三角形。
evidence.en: Complete a triangle by plotting the third vertex at given coordinates and drawing sides

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}网格上的三组坐标点，他们能否标出每个点，然后连接各点画出正确的三角形或矩形？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} is given three coordinate pairs on a grid, can they plot each point and then connect the dots to draw the correct triangle or rectangle?

description.zh: 将位置之间的移动描述为给定单位的平移，包括向左/右和向上/下移动。
description.en: Describe movements between positions as translations of a given unit to the left/right and up/down

evidence.zh: 能描述从(2,3)到(5,3)的平移为向右平移3个单位。
evidence.en: Describe moving from (2,3) to (5,3) as 3 units to the right

evidence.zh: 能按“右4、上2”平移图形，并写出平移后各顶点的坐标。
evidence.en: Translate a shape 4 units right and 2 units up and state the new coordinates

evidence.zh: 能预测点的平移结果
evidence.en: Predict where a point will be after a given translation

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果一个图形在网格上的位置是(2, 3)，你让{{name}}把它向右移动四格、向上移动两格，他/她能在不先画图的情况下算出它的新位置吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If a shape is at position (2, 3) on a grid and you tell {{name}} to move it four squares right and two squares up, can they work out its new position without drawing it first?

description.zh: 在二维网格上，用第一象限的坐标描述位置
description.en: Describe positions on a 2-D grid as coordinates in the first quadrant

evidence.zh: 能在方格纸上读出某一点的坐标，如(3, 5)。
evidence.en: Read the coordinates of a point on a grid as (3, 5)

evidence.zh: 说明第一个数是水平距离，第二个数是垂直距离。
evidence.en: Explain that the first number is the horizontal distance and the second is the vertical distance

evidence.zh: 能在方格纸上确定图形各顶点的坐标
evidence.en: Identify the coordinates of all vertices of a shape plotted on a grid

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}在玩网格寻宝地图游戏，他们能否从角落开始用两个数字正确说出宝藏的位置——比如“横向三格、向上四格”？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} is playing a grid-based treasure map game, can they correctly say where the treasure is using two numbers — like "three across and four up" — from the corner?

description.zh: 根据给定的对称轴，补全一个简单的对称图形
description.en: Complete a simple symmetric figure with respect to a specific line of symmetry

evidence.zh: 给定对称轴和蝴蝶图形的一半，能在方格纸上画出另一半。
evidence.en: Given half a butterfly shape and a mirror line, complete the other half on a grid

evidence.zh: 在方格纸上补全以竖直线为对称轴的轴对称图形
evidence.en: Complete a symmetric pattern on squared paper with a vertical line of symmetry

evidence.zh: 能沿对称轴对折并验证已画出的图形。
evidence.en: Check a completed figure by folding along the mirror line

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}看一个画在方格纸上、标有对称轴的半截图形，他们能否画出缺失的另一半，使整个图形完全对称？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you show {{name}} half a shape drawn on squared paper with a mirror line marked, can they draw the missing half so the whole shape is perfectly symmetrical?

description.zh: 识别、绘制并解释常见立体图形（正方体、长方体、三棱柱和四棱锥）的展开图——通过预测给定的平面图形折叠后会变成哪种立体图形，检查展开图是否能完全闭合，以及根据描述或立体模型画出展开图；理解面数与展开图结构之间的关系。
description.en: Identify, draw, and interpret nets of common 3-D shapes — cubes, cuboids, triangular prisms, and square-based pyramids — by predicting which 3-D shape a given flat arrangement of faces will fold into, checking whether a net will close completely, and sketching a net from a description or 3-D model; understand the relationship between the number of faces and the structure of the net

evidence.zh: 能画出正方体、长方体或三棱柱的展开图，并能通过空间想象判断折叠后哪些面相邻。
evidence.en: Draw the net of a cube, cuboid, or triangular prism and fold it mentally to identify which faces connect

evidence.zh: 能根据展开图制作立体模型，并核对面、棱、顶点是否对应一致。
evidence.en: Build a 3-D shape from its net and check that all faces, edges, and vertices match

evidence.zh: 能在给定展开图中识别出可折叠成指定立体图形的展开图，并说明其他展开图不能折叠的原因。
evidence.en: Identify which of several given nets will fold into a specific 3-D shape and explain why the others won't

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}一张由六个正方形组成的T形平面展开图，他们能否在折叠之前判断出这可以折成一个正方体，并指出哪个正方形会变成哪个面？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} is given a flat T-shaped piece of card with six squares, can they tell you — before folding — that it makes a cube, and point out which square will become each face?

description.zh: 在方格纸或坐标网格上表示并进行几何变换：轴对称（关于水平、垂直和对角线对称轴，包括坐标轴）、平移（用向量或左右上下移动描述）和旋转（围绕指定中心点旋转90°或180°）；用准确的语言精确描述每种变换；通过比较位置、方向和大小，识别哪种变换将一个图形映射到它的像。
description.en: Represent and carry out geometric transformations on squared paper or a coordinate grid: reflections (in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal mirror lines, including the axes), translations (described as a vector or as left/right/up/down moves), and rotations (90° or 180° about a stated centre point); describe each transformation precisely using the correct language; identify which transformation maps one shape onto its image by comparing position, orientation, and size

evidence.zh: 能在方格纸上根据给定的对称轴画出图形的轴对称图形，并写出对应点的坐标。
evidence.en: Reflect a shape in a given mirror line on a grid and label the new coordinates

evidence.zh: 能在方格纸上将简单图形沿水平方向或垂直方向平移，并能描述平移的过程。
evidence.en: Translate a shape by a given number of squares horizontally and vertically and describe the movement

evidence.zh: 能在方格纸上画出简单图形绕指定点旋转90°或180°后的图形，并判断旋转前后图形是否全等。
evidence.en: Rotate a shape 90° or 180° about a given centre on a grid and check the image is congruent to the original

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}在方格纸上看到一个图形及其镜像，他们能否准确画出对称轴，并精确描述这一反射——包括反射线的位置——而不是只说“它翻过来了”？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} sees a shape and its mirror image on squared paper, can they draw in the exact mirror line, and describe the reflection precisely — including where the line of reflection is — without just saying 'it flipped'?

description.zh: 识别锐角和钝角；比较和按大小排列最多两个直角的角
description.en: Identify acute and obtuse angles; compare and order angles up to two right angles by size

evidence.zh: 将给定角分类为锐角、直角或钝角
evidence.en: Classify given angles as acute, right, or obtuse

evidence.zh: 通过观察比较，将四个角按从小到大的顺序排列。
evidence.en: Order four angles from smallest to largest by visual comparison

evidence.zh: 在给定三角形或四边形中，识别所有锐角和钝角。
evidence.en: Identify all acute and obtuse angles in a given triangle or quadrilateral

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}看到一个显示不同时间的钟表，他们能指出哪两根指针之间的角是锐角（比直角小）、哪两根指针之间的角是钝角（比直角大）吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} looks at the hands on a clock showing different times, can they tell you which angle between the hands is acute (sharper than a right angle) and which is obtuse (wider)?

description.zh: 使用并理解标准几何图形约定：用小正方形标记直角，用单或双短划线标记等长线段，用弧线标记等角；用三个字母的符号（∠ABC）标记角，用单个字母或数字标记单独的角；绘制展示点上的角、直线上的角和多边形内角的图形，并应用这些约定；阅读带有这些标记的图形，以识别已知信息并找出未知值。
description.en: Use and interpret standard geometric diagram conventions: mark right angles with a small square, equal lengths with single or double tick marks, and equal angles with arc marks; label angles in three-letter notation (∠ABC) and individual angles with a single letter or number; draw diagrams showing angles at a point, angles on a straight line, and angles inside polygons with these conventions; read diagrams with these marks to identify given information and find unknown values

evidence.zh: 能在图中用直角符号标出直角，并说明其含义
evidence.en: Mark a right angle with a small square symbol in a diagram and explain what it means

evidence.zh: 用单标记表示图形中的等长边，用双标记表示另一组等长边。
evidence.en: Use tick marks to show equal lengths in a shape and double tick marks for a second pair of equal sides

evidence.zh: 能认读并解释角的表示方法（如∠ABC），并在图中指出所表示的角。
evidence.en: Read and interpret angle notation (e.g. angle ABC) and identify the angle being referred to in a diagram

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}的数学图形中一个角标有小正方形，另外两个角标有相匹配的弧线标记，他们能否说出每个标记的含义——并利用这些标记在不重新测量的情况下求出一个缺失的角度？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}}'s maths diagram shows a small square in one corner and matching arc marks on two other angles, can they tell you what each mark means — and use them to figure out a missing angle without re-measuring?

description.zh: 理解不同类别的图形可能共享属性，从而构成更大的类别；对四边形（菱形、长方形、正方形）进行分类，并画出不属于这些子类别的四边形示例。
description.en: Understand that shapes in different categories may share attributes defining a larger category; classify quadrilaterals (rhombuses, rectangles, squares) and draw examples of quadrilaterals not in those subcategories

evidence.zh: 能说明正方形既是特殊的矩形，也是特殊的菱形。
evidence.en: Explain that a square is a special rectangle and also a special rhombus

evidence.zh: 能将四边形、长方形和正方形分类填入维恩图。
evidence.en: Sort shapes into a Venn diagram: quadrilaterals vs rectangles vs squares

evidence.zh: 能画出一个既不是长方形、菱形，也不是正方形的四边形。
evidence.en: Draw a quadrilateral that is not a rectangle, rhombus, or square

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}看一个正方形、一个长方形和一个菱形，他们能否解释为什么它们都是四边形——以及每一个与其他图形有什么不同？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you show {{name}} a square, a rectangle, and a rhombus, can they explain what makes them all quadrilaterals — and what makes each one different from the others?

description.zh: 从二维图形中识别立体图形，包括正方体和其他长方体
description.en: Identify 3-D shapes, including cubes and other cuboids, from 2-D representations

evidence.zh: 能根据展开图识别长方体
evidence.en: Identify a cuboid from its net

evidence.zh: 能识别等轴测图所表示的立体图形
evidence.en: Name the 3-D shape shown in an isometric drawing

evidence.zh: 能将二维图形与对应的三维形状进行匹配
evidence.en: Match 2-D representations to the correct 3-D shape

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}看一张画在平面建筑师草稿上的正方体或金字塔，他们能说出它代表的立体图形名称吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you show {{name}} a flat architect's sketch of a box or a pyramid, can they tell you the name of the 3-D shape it represents?

description.zh: 知道一个点周围的角度总和为360°（一整圈），直线上的角度总和为180°，对顶角相等；运用这些事实来求缺失的角度。
description.en: Know that angles at a point sum to 360° (one whole turn), angles on a straight line sum to 180°, and vertically opposite angles are equal; use these facts to find missing angles

evidence.zh: 能说出同一直线上两个角的和为180°
evidence.en: State that two angles on a straight line add to 180°

evidence.zh: 说明一点处的四个直角构成360°。
evidence.en: Explain that four right angles at a point make 360°

evidence.zh: 理解270°等于三个直角
evidence.en: Identify 270° as three right angles

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果三个角相交于一点，其中两个角分别是120°和95°，{{name}}能否在已知围绕一点的所有角之和为360°的情况下，算出第三个角？
assessmentPrompt.en: If three angles meet at a point and two of them are 120° and 95°, can {{name}} work out the third angle — knowing all the angles at a point add up to 360°?

name.zh: 根据线的性质分类图形

description.zh: 根据平行线或垂直线是否存在，或特定大小的角，对二维图形进行分类；认识直角三角形是一个类别
description.en: Classify two-dimensional figures based on the presence or absence of parallel or perpendicular lines, or angles of a specified size; recognise right triangles as a category

evidence.zh: 根据四边形是否有平行边，将其分为两类。
evidence.en: Sort a set of quadrilaterals into those with parallel sides and those without

evidence.zh: 在三角形中识别直角三角形
evidence.en: Identify which triangles in a set are right triangles

evidence.zh: 对既有垂直边又有平行边的图形进行分类。
evidence.en: Classify shapes that have both perpendicular and parallel sides

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}展示一组混合的三角形和四边形，他们能否根据“至少有一个直角”或“有平行边”等特征进行分类，并解释自己的推理过程？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you show {{name}} a mixed set of triangles and quadrilaterals, can they sort them into groups — like "shapes with at least one right angle" or "shapes with parallel sides" — and explain their reasoning?

description.zh: 知道角度用度来测量，其中1度是完整旋转的1/360；理解一个角度旋转了n个1度角，它的度数就是n度。
description.en: Know that angles are measured in degrees, where one degree is 1/360 of a full turn; understand that an angle turning through n one-degree angles has a measure of n degrees

evidence.zh: 理解并掌握周角为360°、直角为90°。
evidence.en: Explain that a full turn is 360° and a right angle is 90°

evidence.zh: 描述“一度”作为圆的几分之几的含义
evidence.en: Describe what 'one degree' means in terms of a fraction of a circle

evidence.zh: 说明45°的角旋转经过了45个1°的角。
evidence.en: State that an angle of 45° has turned through 45 one-degree angles

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}知道一个完整的圆是360度，他们能否告诉你四分之一圈是多少度——并大致解释一度看起来是怎样的？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} knows a full circle is 360 degrees, can they tell you how many degrees a quarter turn is — and explain roughly what one single degree looks like?

description.zh: 估计并比较锐角、钝角和优角的度数；按类型对角进行分类，并按大小排序。
description.en: Estimate and compare acute, obtuse, and reflex angles in degrees; classify angles by type and order them by size

evidence.zh: 能估计角的大小约为130°，并判断该角为钝角
evidence.en: Estimate an angle as approximately 130° and classify it as obtuse

evidence.zh: 能在图中识别优角，并估计其大小约为270°。
evidence.en: Identify a reflex angle in a diagram and estimate it as about 270°

evidence.zh: 先估后测，将四个角按从小到大的顺序排列。
evidence.en: Order four angles from smallest to largest by estimation before measuring

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}看纸上画出的三个不同角，他们能估计出哪个角最大，把每个角标注为锐角、钝角或优角，然后用量角器进行验证吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you show {{name}} three different angles drawn on paper, can they estimate which is biggest, label each as acute, obtuse, or reflex — and then check with a protractor?

description.zh: 绘制并识别点、直线、线段、射线、角（直角、锐角、钝角）以及垂直和平行线；在二维图形中识别这些元素
description.en: Draw and identify points, lines, line segments, rays, angles (right, acute, obtuse), and perpendicular and parallel lines; identify these in two-dimensional figures

evidence.zh: 能画出一组垂线和平行线
evidence.en: Draw a pair of perpendicular lines and a pair of parallel lines

evidence.zh: 识别梯形中的所有平行边对
evidence.en: Identify all pairs of parallel sides in a trapezoid

evidence.zh: 在给定图形中识别并标出一个直角、一个锐角和一个钝角
evidence.en: Mark a right angle, an acute angle, and an obtuse angle in a given figure

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}一张纸和一把尺子，他们能否画出一条线段、标出一个点，然后经过该点再画一条与第一条线段完全平行的线？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} is given a piece of paper and a ruler, can they draw a line segment, mark a point, and then draw another line through that point that runs perfectly parallel to the first?

description.zh: 使用量角器测量整度数角度；画出给定角度，并画出指定度数的角
description.en: Measure angles in whole-number degrees using a protractor; draw given angles and sketch angles of specified measure

evidence.zh: 用量角器量角并读出47°
evidence.en: Measure an angle with a protractor and read 47°

evidence.zh: 能借助量角器画出135°的角
evidence.en: Draw an angle of 135° using a protractor

evidence.zh: 能在量角器上识别用于测量钝角的刻度。
evidence.en: Identify which scale on the protractor to use for an obtuse angle

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}一个量角器和纸上画好的一个角，他们能否准确测量这个角，然后画出一个你指定大小的新角？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} is given a protractor and an angle drawn on paper, can they measure it accurately and then draw a new angle of a size you specify?

description.zh: 认识角的度量具有可加性；通过在图示上使用含有未知数符号的等式进行加法或减法，求出未知角。
description.en: Recognise angle measure as additive; find unknown angles by adding or subtracting on a diagram using equations with a symbol for the unknown

evidence.zh: 掌握标准：能根据同一直线上的邻补角关系，由已知角65°求出另一个角x=115°。
evidence.en: Two angles on a straight line are 65° and x°; find x = 115°

evidence.zh: 能根据一个角可分成35°和40°得出该角为75°。
evidence.en: An angle is decomposed into 35° and 40°; state the whole angle is 75°

evidence.zh: 掌握：同一点处的角分别为120°、90°和x°，求x = 150°。
evidence.en: Solve: angles at a point are 120°, 90°, and x°; find x = 150°

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果两个角在同一条直线上且相邻，其中一个角是65°，{{name}}能否根据“同一直线上的角相加等于180°”算出另一个角？
assessmentPrompt.en: If two angles sit next to each other on a straight line and one is 65°, can {{name}} work out the other angle — knowing that angles on a straight line always add up to 180°?

name.zh: 正多边形与不规则多边形

description.zh: 通过推理边长和角是否相等，区分正多边形和不规则多边形。
description.en: Distinguish between regular and irregular polygons based on reasoning about equal sides and equal angles

evidence.zh: 将一组多边形分类为规则或不规则多边形
evidence.en: Classify a set of polygons as regular or irregular

evidence.zh: 说出正五边形有5条相等的边和5个相等的角
evidence.en: Explain that a regular pentagon has 5 equal sides and 5 equal angles

evidence.zh: 能识别长方形（四角相等但边不全相等）属于不规则图形，正方形除外。
evidence.en: Identify that a rectangle is irregular (equal angles but not all equal sides) unless it is a square

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你给{{name}}看一个停车标志（正八边形）和一个歪斜的八边形，他们能说出哪个是正多边形、哪个是不规则多边形——并说明原因吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you show {{name}} a stop sign (regular octagon) and a wonky eight-sided shape, can they explain which is regular and which is irregular — and why?

description.zh: 使用适当的语言识别、描述和表示图形经过反射或平移后的位置；知道图形的形状没有改变。
description.en: Identify, describe, and represent the position of a shape following a reflection or translation using appropriate language; know that the shape has not changed

evidence.zh: 能在坐标网格中画出三角形关于竖直镜像线的对称图形，并写出对应顶点的新坐标。
evidence.en: Reflect a triangle in a vertical mirror line on a coordinate grid and state the new coordinates

evidence.zh: 能在方格纸上按要求画出简单图形平移后的图形（如向右平移3格、向上平移2格），并能用“向某方向平移几格”描述平移过程。
evidence.en: Translate a shape 3 units right and 2 units up and describe the movement

evidence.zh: 能说明反射/平移后的图形与原图形全等
evidence.en: Explain that a reflected/translated shape is congruent to the original

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}在方格纸上平移或翻转一个图形，他们能否准确描述图形最终的位置，并确认图形本身的大小和角度没有改变？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} slides or flips a shape on squared paper, can they describe exactly where it ends up and confirm the shape itself hasn't changed size or angles?

description.zh: 利用长方形的性质推导相关事实，并求出缺失的边长和角度
description.en: Use the properties of rectangles to deduce related facts and find missing lengths and angles

evidence.zh: 已知长方形的一条边长为8厘米，周长为28厘米，求另一条边长。
evidence.en: Given one side of a rectangle is 8 cm and the perimeter is 28 cm, find the other side

evidence.zh: 能说出矩形的四个角都是直角。
evidence.en: Explain that all angles in a rectangle are 90°

evidence.zh: 已知长方形面积和一条边长，求另一条边长
evidence.en: Find a missing side of a rectangle given its area and one side length

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}知道一个长方形花园的一条边是7米，他能否在不测量的情况下说出对边的长度和四个角的度数？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} knows one side of a rectangular garden is 7 m, can they tell you the length of the opposite side and all four corner angles — without measuring?

description.zh: 理解角是由两条有公共端点（顶点）的射线组成的几何图形；能在现实生活和二维图形中识别角。
description.en: Understand that an angle is a geometric shape formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint (vertex); recognise angles in real-life contexts and 2-D shapes

evidence.zh: 能在图中标出角的顶点和边
evidence.en: Identify the vertex and arms of an angle in a diagram

evidence.zh: 能在教室中找出角的实例（如打开的门、钟表指针）
evidence.en: Find examples of angles in the classroom (e.g. open door, clock hands)

evidence.zh: 阐述两条射线相交于一点形成一个角的原因
evidence.en: Explain why two rays meeting at a point form an angle

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果在纸上从同一个点出发画两条线，{{name}}能否指出它们之间的空间就是一个角，并说出两条线相交的顶点？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you draw two lines starting from the same point on paper, can {{name}} tell you that the space between them is an angle — and point to the vertex where they meet?

description.zh: 使用给定的尺寸和角度，用直尺和量角器准确地绘制二维图形
description.en: Draw 2-D shapes using given dimensions and angles, using a ruler and protractor accurately

evidence.zh: 能画出两边长分别为5厘米、7厘米且夹角为60°的三角形
evidence.en: Draw a triangle with sides 5 cm, 7 cm and an included angle of 60°

evidence.zh: 能借助直尺和三角尺，按给定的长和宽画出长方形。
evidence.en: Construct a rectangle with given length and width using a ruler and set square

evidence.zh: 已知边长及一个内角，作正五边形
evidence.en: Draw a regular pentagon given the side length and interior angle

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果让{{name}}画一个两边长分别为5厘米和7厘米、夹角为40°的三角形，他/她能使用直尺和量角器准确画出吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you ask {{name}} to draw a triangle with sides of 5 cm and 7 cm with a 40° angle between them, can they use a ruler and protractor to draw it accurately?

description.zh: 认识、描述和制作简单的立体图形，包括制作展开图
description.en: Recognise, describe, and build simple 3-D shapes, including making nets

evidence.zh: 能根据展开图判断能否折成指定立体图形
evidence.en: Identify which net will fold into a given 3-D shape

evidence.zh: 能画出三棱柱的展开图，并通过折叠验证其是否正确。
evidence.en: Construct the net of a triangular prism and fold it to verify

evidence.zh: 通过描述面、棱和顶点识别三维图形
evidence.en: Describe a 3-D shape by naming its faces, edges, and vertices

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}一张平面的十字形卡片（一个展开图），他们能预测折叠后会形成什么立体图形，然后折叠来验证吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} is given a flat cross-shaped piece of card (a net), can they predict what 3-D shape it will make when folded up — and then fold it to check?

description.zh: 利用角度和性质，求三角形、四边形和正多边形中的未知角。
description.en: Find unknown angles in triangles, quadrilaterals, and regular polygons using angle sum properties

evidence.zh: 已知两角求第三角（利用三角形内角和为180°）
evidence.en: Find a missing angle in a triangle given two angles (using angle sum = 180°)

evidence.zh: 计算四边形中缺失的角度（内角和为360°）
evidence.en: Calculate a missing angle in a quadrilateral (angle sum = 360°)

evidence.zh: 运用多边形内角和公式求正六边形每个内角的度数
evidence.en: Calculate the interior angle of a regular hexagon from the angle sum formula

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}知道三角形内角和总是180°，且三角形中有两个角分别是55°和70°，他们能在不测量的情况下算出第三个角吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} knows that angles in a triangle always add up to 180°, and two angles in a triangle are 55° and 70°, can they work out the third angle without measuring it?

description.zh: 根据图形的属性和大小进行比较和分类；理解属于某一类别的属性也属于其所有子类别；根据属性将二维图形按层级分类。
description.en: Compare and classify geometric shapes based on their properties and sizes; understand that attributes belonging to a category also belong to all subcategories; classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties

evidence.zh: 解释为什么所有正方形都是矩形，但并非所有矩形都是正方形。
evidence.en: Explain why all squares are rectangles but not all rectangles are squares

evidence.zh: 在层级图中表示四边形，体现子集关系。
evidence.en: Place quadrilaterals in a hierarchy diagram showing subset relationships

evidence.zh: 掌握平行四边形所有共同性质，并解释菱形和矩形是其特殊情形的原因。
evidence.en: Identify properties shared by all parallelograms and explain why rhombuses and rectangles are special cases

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果有人问{{name}}“正方形也是长方形吗？”，他们能否解释为什么答案是肯定的——因为正方形具备长方形的所有性质，并且四条边相等？
assessmentPrompt.en: If someone asks {{name}} "is a square also a rectangle?", can they explain why the answer is yes — because a square has all the properties of a rectangle plus equal sides?

description.zh: 在完整的坐标网格（四个象限）上描述位置；使用带有负值的坐标。
description.en: Describe positions on the full coordinate grid (all four quadrants); use coordinates with negative values

evidence.zh: 在四象限网格中描出含负坐标的点，如（−3, 4）和（2, −5）。
evidence.en: Plot points with negative coordinates such as (−3, 4) and (2, −5) on a four-quadrant grid

evidence.zh: 能判断给定点位于哪个象限
evidence.en: Identify the quadrant in which a given point lies

evidence.zh: 能在平面直角坐标系中根据坐标确定图形的位置。
evidence.en: Describe the position of a shape using coordinates in all four quadrants

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}在玩一个船只也可以位于负坐标的游戏，他们能否在网格上正确标出并读出像（−3, 2）或（1, −4）这样的位置？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} is playing a game where ships can be at negative coordinates too, can they correctly plot and read positions like (−3, 2) or (1, −4) on a grid?

description.zh: 理解由两条垂直数轴（坐标轴）定义的坐标系，原点为(0,0)；知道有序数对(x, y)指定一个唯一的点，其中第一个数表示水平方向到原点的距离，第二个数表示垂直方向到原点的距离。
description.en: Understand a coordinate system defined by two perpendicular number lines (axes) with an origin at (0,0); know that an ordered pair (x, y) specifies a unique point where the first number gives horizontal distance and the second gives vertical distance from the origin

evidence.zh: 能在坐标网格中识别x轴、y轴和原点。
evidence.en: Identify the x-axis, y-axis, and origin on a coordinate grid

evidence.zh: 能说明(3, 5)表示先沿x轴移动3个单位，再沿y轴向上移动5个单位。
evidence.en: Explain that (3, 5) means go 3 along the x-axis and 5 up the y-axis

evidence.zh: 能通过解释各坐标的含义区分(2, 4)与(4, 2)。
evidence.en: Distinguish (2, 4) from (4, 2) by explaining each coordinate's meaning

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}看一张带网格的地图，你把一个位置描述为“从原点向右3格、向上5格”，他能否找到确切的点，并解释这两个数字各自代表什么？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} looks at a map with a grid and you describe a location as "3 across and 5 up from the origin", can they find the exact point — and explain what each of the two numbers tells you?

description.zh: 画出并命名圆的各部分，包括半径、直径和周长；知道直径是半径的两倍。
description.en: Illustrate and name parts of circles, including radius, diameter, and circumference; know that the diameter is twice the radius

evidence.zh: 在圆上识别并标注半径、直径和周长
evidence.en: Label the radius, diameter, and circumference on a circle diagram

evidence.zh: 已知半径4.5厘米，求直径（直径＝9厘米）
evidence.en: Calculate the diameter given a radius of 4.5 cm (diameter = 9 cm)

evidence.zh: 用自己的话解释半径与直径的关系
evidence.en: Explain the relationship between radius and diameter in their own words

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果给{{name}}一个圆盘和一把尺子，他们能测量出直径，并解释半径与直径的关系吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you give {{name}} a round plate and a ruler, can they measure the diameter — and explain how the radius compares to the diameter?

name.en: Plotting points in the first quadrant

description.zh: 在坐标平面的第一象限中绘制和读取有序数对；通过绘制点并在情境中解释坐标值来表示现实世界和数学问题
description.en: Plot and read ordered pairs in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane; represent real-world and mathematical problems by graphing points and interpreting coordinate values in context

evidence.zh: 能在第一象限网格中准确标出点(4, 7)
evidence.en: Plot the point (4, 7) accurately on a first-quadrant grid

evidence.zh: 在坐标平面上标出表示数据对（如时间与距离）的点。
evidence.en: Graph a set of data pairs (e.g. time vs distance) as points on the coordinate plane

evidence.zh: 能根据图象读出点的坐标，并结合具体情境说明其实际意义。
evidence.en: Read coordinates of a plotted point and explain what they represent in a given scenario

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你告诉{{name}}一段汽车旅程经过地图上的格点(2, 3)、(5, 7)和(8, 4)，他们能否标出这些点并描述这段旅程的样子？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you tell {{name}} a car journey passes through grid points (2, 3), (5, 7), and (8, 4) on a map, can they plot those points and describe what the journey looks like?

description.zh: 在坐标平面上绘制和平移简单图形；沿坐标轴对图形进行对称变换
description.en: Draw and translate simple shapes on the coordinate plane; reflect shapes in the axes

evidence.zh: 能在坐标网格中画出三角形向右平移3个单位、向下平移2个单位后的图形，并写出平移后各顶点的坐标。
evidence.en: Translate a triangle 3 units right and 2 units down on a coordinate grid and state the new coordinates

evidence.zh: 能在坐标系中作出对称图形，并写出对称后各顶点的坐标。
evidence.en: Reflect a shape in the x-axis and list the coordinates of the reflected vertices

evidence.zh: 解释平移如何改变坐标（加/减），而对称如何改变一个坐标的符号。
evidence.en: Explain how translation changes coordinates (add/subtract) while reflection changes the sign of one coordinate

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}在网格上画出坐标为(1, 2)、(3, 2)和(2, 4)的三角形，他们能否将其沿x轴翻转，并说出每个顶点的新坐标？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} draws a triangle at coordinates (1, 2), (3, 2), and (2, 4) on a grid, can they then reflect it across the x-axis and tell you the new coordinates of each corner?

description.zh: 认识相交于一点、位于同一直线上或对顶的角；利用这些性质求未知角。
description.en: Recognise angles where they meet at a point, are on a straight line, or are vertically opposite; find missing angles using these properties

evidence.zh: 已知其余角，求同一点缺失角（总和360°）
evidence.en: Find a missing angle at a point given the other angles (total 360°)

evidence.zh: 运用平角性质（角和为180°）求未知角
evidence.en: Use the straight-line property (angles sum to 180°) to find an unknown angle

evidence.zh: 理解对顶角的概念，并能运用对顶角相等的性质求未知角的度数。
evidence.en: Identify vertically opposite angles and use the property that they are equal to find unknowns

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果两条直线相交，{{name}}能否说出哪些角相等（对顶角）——并且在已知其中一个角的情况下求出其余的角？
assessmentPrompt.en: If two straight lines cross each other, can {{name}} tell you which pairs of angles are equal (vertically opposite) — and find a missing angle if you give them one of the others?

description.zh: 利用立体图形（正方体、长方体、棱柱、圆柱、棱锥、圆锥和球体）的面、表面、棱和顶点的性质来解决问题，包括想象横截面
description.en: Use the properties of faces, surfaces, edges, and vertices of 3-D shapes (cubes, cuboids, prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones, and spheres) to solve problems, including visualising cross-sections

evidence.zh: 数出并描述三棱柱和四棱锥的面、棱和顶点。
evidence.en: Count and describe the faces, edges, and vertices of a triangular prism and a square-based pyramid

evidence.zh: 描述水平截圆柱或竖直截圆锥所得的二维截面。
evidence.en: Describe the 2-D cross-section produced by slicing a cylinder horizontally or a cone vertically

evidence.zh: 能根据立体图形的性质，判断给定展开图能否折叠成指定立体图形。
evidence.en: Use properties of 3-D shapes to determine whether a given net will fold into a specified solid

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}把一个圆柱体从中间水平切开，就像把一罐豆子切成两半那样，他们能描述出截面的形状吗？那如果是斜着切呢？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} slices a cylinder straight across the middle like cutting a tin of beans in half, can they describe the shape of the cut surface? What about slicing at an angle?

description.zh: 推导并应用三角形、平行四边形和梯形的面积公式，以及长方体和其他棱柱（包括圆柱）的体积公式，并将每个公式与其几何推理联系起来。
description.en: Derive and apply formulae for the area of triangles, parallelograms, and trapezia, and for the volume of cuboids and other prisms (including cylinders), connecting each formula to its geometric reasoning

evidence.zh: 能运用梯形面积公式 A = ½(a + b) × h 进行计算，并解释公式的推导过程。
evidence.en: Calculate the area of a trapezium using A = ½(a + b) × h and explain why the formula works

evidence.zh: 掌握用底面积×高计算三棱柱体积的方法
evidence.en: Find the volume of a triangular prism by calculating cross-sectional area × length

evidence.zh: 由棱柱体积公式推导出圆柱体积公式πr²h
evidence.en: Derive the formula for the volume of a cylinder as π × r² × h by reasoning from the prism formula

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}需要给露台的一个三角形区域铺地砖，这个区域的底为4米、高为3米，他们能算出面积来确定需要买多少块地砖吗？

evidence.en: Use positional words (above, below, next to) precisely to describe where objects are

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}谈论数学时——比如比较数字或描述形状——他们是否会使用正确的词汇，如“大于”、“少于”、“旁边”或“角”？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} talks about maths — like comparing numbers or describing shapes — do they use the right words, like "larger than", "fewer", "beside", or "corner"?

description.zh: 注意到计算或规律中的重复现象，并利用它来更高效地数数或预测结果。
description.en: Notice when a calculation or pattern repeats and use this to count more efficiently or predict results

evidence.zh: 注意：隔2个数跳数时，遵循奇偶交替的规律。
evidence.en: Notice that skip counting by 2s follows a repeating odd/even pattern

evidence.zh: 理解任何数加1即为下一个计数数
evidence.en: Recognise that adding 1 to any number always gives the next counting number

evidence.zh: 运用重复规律（如百数表中加10总是向下移动一行）预测结果
evidence.en: Use a repeated pattern (e.g. +10 on a hundred chart always moves down one row) to predict answers

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在进行数数或连加时，是否已开始注意到其中的规律——比如“5、10、15、20……”——并能利用这一规律预测下一个数，而无需逐一数数？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is counting or doing repeated additions, have they started to notice the pattern — like "5, 10, 15, 20…" — and used it to predict the next number without counting one by one?

description.zh: 选择并使用熟悉的工具（实物、手指、十格阵）来帮助解决数学问题
description.en: Select and use familiar tools (concrete objects, fingers, ten frames) to help solve a mathematical problem

evidence.zh: 借助方块、计数器或手指进行加减法运算。
evidence.en: Choose cubes, counters, or fingers to help solve an addition or subtraction problem

evidence.zh: 借助十格阵摆放物体，进行计数或比较。
evidence.en: Use a ten frame to organise objects for counting or comparing

evidence.zh: 阐述在解决特定问题时选择特定工具（如用方块而非手指）的理由。
evidence.en: Explain why a particular tool (e.g. cubes rather than fingers) was chosen for a given problem

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在解数学题时，是否会借助辅助工具——如手指、计数器或数轴——来帮助思考？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is working out a maths problem, do they reach for helpful tools — like using their fingers, counters, or a number line — to support their thinking?

description.zh: 通过识别问题在问什么、选择具体物体或图片来表示情境、并解释解题路径来理解问题
description.en: Make sense of a problem by identifying what is being asked, choosing concrete objects or pictures to represent the situation, and explaining a pathway to the solution

evidence.zh: 在10以内应用题情境中，能在作答前说出题目要求。
evidence.en: When given a word problem within 10, explain what the problem is asking before attempting to solve

evidence.zh: 能用实物、手指或图形表征问题情境
evidence.en: Choose objects, fingers, or drawings to represent a problem situation

evidence.zh: 得出答案后，能检验其合理性（如通过重新点数物体验证总数）。
evidence.en: After finding an answer, check it makes sense (e.g. re-count objects to verify a total)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}遇到一道不能立刻解出的数学题时，他们是否会先停下来思考题目在问什么——也许会画个图——然后再动手解题？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} gets a maths problem they don't immediately know how to solve, do they stop and think about what the question is asking — maybe drawing a picture — before diving in?

name.zh: 从现实世界到数学的联系

description.zh: 在现实情境和数学表达之间转换，使用具体物体、图画、图表、表格、数字算式或条形模型
description.en: Move between a real-world situation and a mathematical representation using concrete objects, drawings, diagrams, tables, number sentences, or bar models

evidence.zh: 能在合并情境中借助计数器或方块表示数量并求出总数。
evidence.en: Given a story about combining groups, represent it with counters or cubes and find the total

evidence.zh: 能根据给定的物体数量，自编一道简单的加法或减法应用题。
evidence.en: Given a set of objects, tell a simple addition or subtraction story to match

evidence.zh: 能将实物操作（合并、拿走）与对应运算建立联系
evidence.en: Connect a physical action (putting together, taking away) to the matching operation

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}正在解决一个现实生活中的数学问题——比如把8颗糖分给2个人——他们能否在写任何数字之前，先用实物或画图来表示发生了什么？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} is working out a real-life maths problem — like sharing 8 sweets between 2 people — can they use objects or draw a picture to show what's happening before writing any numbers?

description.zh: 用实物、图画和口头语言展示并说明数学答案是如何得到的
description.en: Show and tell how a mathematical answer was found using objects, drawings, and spoken words

evidence.zh: 能用实物或图形演示加减法的运算过程。
evidence.en: Use objects or drawings to demonstrate how an addition or subtraction was solved

evidence.zh: 能通过指认实物或图片并描述操作过程，回答“你怎么知道的？”
evidence.en: Respond to 'how do you know?' by pointing to objects or a drawing and describing what was done

evidence.zh: 倾听同伴的解释并表达是否认同
evidence.en: Listen to a peer's explanation and say whether they agree or disagree

assessmentPrompt.zh: 在{{name}}解完一道数学题后，他们能否通过教具、画图或语言来解释自己是如何得出答案的，而不只是写下最终的数字？
assessmentPrompt.en: After {{name}} solves a maths problem, can they explain how they got their answer — using counters, a drawing, or words — rather than just writing down the final number?

description.zh: 注意简单的规律和结构：发现改变顺序不会改变总数，并认识数字之间的相互关系。
description.en: Notice simple patterns and structures: spot that changing order doesn't change the total, and recognise how numbers relate to each other

evidence.zh: 理解3+2与2+3结果相同（早期交换律）
evidence.en: Notice that 3 + 2 gives the same answer as 2 + 3 (early commutativity)

evidence.zh: 掌握十几的组成（如14由10和4组成）。
evidence.en: Recognise that teen numbers are 'ten and some more' (e.g. 14 is 10 and 4)

evidence.zh: 能识别物体或数字序列中的规律，并预测下一项。
evidence.en: Spot a pattern in a sequence of objects or numbers and predict what comes next

assessmentPrompt.zh: {{name}}是否理解加法交换律——即改变数字相加的顺序不会改变结果（如3+5和5+3都等于8）——并能解释其合理性？
assessmentPrompt.en: Has {{name}} noticed that adding numbers in a different order gives the same answer — like 3 + 5 and 5 + 3 both equal 8 — and can they explain why that makes sense?

name.en: Using objects to model real problems

description.zh: 用实物、图画或简单的算式来表示一个真实情境（早期数学建模）
description.en: Use objects, drawings, or simple number sentences to represent a real-world situation (early mathematical modelling)

evidence.zh: 能在具体情境中用图画或实物表示简单的计数或比较。
evidence.en: Draw a picture or use objects to represent a simple real-world situation involving counting or comparing

evidence.zh: 能写出或口述一个数字表达式来描述一个真实情境（如“我有5个苹果，吃了2个”）。
evidence.en: Write or dictate a number sentence to describe a real-world situation (e.g. 'I had 5 apples and ate 2')

evidence.zh: 能在具体情境中运用模型解决问题
evidence.en: Use the model to answer a question about the situation

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你向{{name}}描述一个简单的现实生活情境——比如“篱笆上有3只鸟，又飞来了2只”——他/她能写出像3 + 2 = 5这样的算式来表示吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you describe a simple real-life situation to {{name}} — like "there are 3 birds on a fence and 2 more land" — can they write a number sentence like 3 + 2 = 5 to represent it?

name.zh: 将数学与生活联系起来

description.zh: 用数字句子、条形模型或图表来表示现实世界中的问题，并将数学结果放回情境中解释。
description.en: Represent real-world problems with number sentences, bar models, or diagrams, and interpret the mathematical result back in context

evidence.zh: 能针对测量或货币类应用题选择并列出正确的算式。
evidence.en: Choose and write an appropriate number sentence for a measurement or money word problem

evidence.zh: 能通过条形图或示意图表征两步问题或比较问题
evidence.en: Draw a bar model or diagram to represent a two-step or comparison problem

evidence.zh: 能在具体情境中解释数值答案的实际含义（如“15厘米表示丝带长15厘米”）。
evidence.en: Interpret the numerical answer in context (e.g. '15 cm means the ribbon is 15 centimetres long')

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}通过画条形图或列方程来解应用题时，他们是否也能解释自己的答案在现实情境中意味着什么——比如“也就是说每个孩子分到4颗糖”？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} solves a word problem by drawing a bar model or writing an equation, can they also explain what their answer means in the real-world context — like "that means each child gets 4 sweets"?

description.zh: 在现实情境、图画和数字算式之间转换，并解释每种表征如何与其他表征相联系（定量推理）
description.en: Move between real-world situations, drawings, and number sentences, explaining how each representation connects to the others (quantitative reasoning)

evidence.zh: 能根据应用题列式（如14+5=19），并说明算式与题意的联系。
evidence.en: Write a number sentence (e.g. 14 + 5 = 19) to match a word problem and explain the connection

evidence.zh: 能画条形模型或部分-整体图表示问题，并借助图示求解。
evidence.en: Draw a bar model or part-whole diagram to represent a problem, then solve using the diagram

evidence.zh: 能在具体情境与符号方程之间相互转换，并说明各数字所表示的含义。
evidence.en: Translate between a concrete model and a symbolic equation, describing what each number represents

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}解决应用题时，他们能否通过画图或列式来表达自己的解题思路，并说明图示和数字与实际情境之间的对应关系？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} solves a word problem, can they draw a diagram or write a number sentence to show their thinking — and then explain how the picture and the numbers match the real situation?

description.zh: 在老师的提示下，用图画、算式或文字解释和证明数学推理
description.en: With teacher prompting, explain and justify mathematical reasoning using drawings, number sentences, or words

evidence.zh: 能用图示或算式说明解题思路（如“先凑十，再加剩余部分”）。
evidence.en: Explain a solution strategy using a drawing or number sentence (e.g. 'I made ten first, then added the rest')

evidence.zh: 能通过展示得出相同结果的另一种方法来验证答案的正确性
evidence.en: Justify why an answer is correct by showing an alternative method that gives the same result

evidence.zh: 指出并解释范例或同伴解法中的错误
evidence.en: Identify and explain an error in a worked example or a peer's solution

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果你问{{name}}“你是怎么算出来的？”，他们能用画图展示，或者用简单的话说明自己的步骤吗？
assessmentPrompt.en: If you ask {{name}} "how did you work that out?", can they show you with a drawing or explain their steps in simple words?

description.zh: 识别并运用重复推理来概括规律：发现计算规律，描述数列的规则，并利用已知的数学事实预测结果。
description.en: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: spot calculation patterns, describe rules for sequences, and predict results using known mathematical facts

evidence.zh: 运用已知的双倍数事实推导近双倍数（如6+7=6+6+1=13）
evidence.en: Use a known doubles fact to derive a near-doubles answer (e.g. 6 + 7 = 6 + 6 + 1 = 13)

evidence.zh: 注意：任何两位数减10，十位数字总是减1。
evidence.en: Notice that subtracting 10 from any two-digit number always reduces the tens digit by 1

evidence.zh: 描述规律并运用规律进行延伸或预测（如“每次加5，个位数字在0和5之间交替”）。
evidence.en: Describe a rule for a pattern and use it to extend or predict (e.g. 'each time we add 5, the ones digit alternates between 0 and 5')

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在练习乘法表或数字规律时，他们是否能发现捷径——比如“如果6×7=42，那么6×8一定是48”——并利用已知的乘法事实来推算尚未记住的？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is practising times tables or number patterns, do they spot a shortcut — like "if 6 × 7 = 42, then 6 × 8 must be 48" — and use known facts to work out ones they haven't memorised yet?

description.zh: 在老师的引导下，通过规划解题路径、识别相关信息并选择适当的运算，理解多步和更复杂的问题
description.en: With teacher guidance, make sense of multi-step and more complex problems by planning a pathway to the solution, identifying relevant information, and choosing appropriate operations

evidence.zh: 在20或100以内应用题中，能识别已知条件和所求问题。
evidence.en: When given a word problem within 20 or 100, identify the known information and what needs to be found

evidence.zh: 尝试一种策略（画图、数轴、已知事实），不成功则换一种方法。
evidence.en: Try a strategy (drawing, number line, known fact) and switch approach if the first attempt stalls

evidence.zh: 能用估算或不同方法检验答案的合理性
evidence.en: Check the reasonableness of an answer using estimation or a different method

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}算出3个孩子每人分到12颗糖、最后还剩5颗，{{name}}会不会停下来想一想“这好像不对”，而不是直接写下来？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} works out that 3 children each get 12 sweets and ends up with 5, does {{name}} pause and say "that doesn't seem right" rather than just writing it down?

description.zh: 选择并使用合适的工具和表示方法（数轴、百数表、尺子、部分-整体模型）来帮助解决问题
description.en: Select and use appropriate tools and representations (number lines, hundred squares, rulers, part-whole models) to support problem-solving

evidence.zh: 能在数轴或百数表上完成两位数加减法运算。
evidence.en: Choose a number line or hundred square to support adding or subtracting two-digit numbers

evidence.zh: 能针对长度测量问题选择合适的尺子。
evidence.en: Select a ruler when a problem requires measuring length

evidence.zh: 解释为何某种表征（如数轴与方块）对特定问题更有帮助
evidence.en: Explain why one representation (e.g. a number line vs cubes) is more helpful for a particular problem

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在解决数学问题时，他们是否会选择有用的工具——比如用数轴做加法或用百数方格来接着数——而不是总是心算？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is tackling a maths problem, do they choose a useful tool — like a number line for addition or a hundred square to count on — rather than always working in their head?

description.zh: 用数学的精确性进行交流：使用正确的词汇，明确单位，并准确使用符号
description.en: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary, specify units, and use symbols accurately

evidence.zh: 正确使用等号“=”表示“与……相同”，而非“答案是”。
evidence.en: Use the = sign correctly to mean 'is the same as' rather than 'the answer is'

evidence.zh: 作答时须带单位（如写“12 cm”而非仅写“12”）。
evidence.en: Include units when giving a measurement answer (e.g. '12 cm' not just '12')

evidence.zh: 能准确使用“棱”“顶点”“面”等术语描述立体图形，能准确使用“大于”“小于”等术语比较数的大小。
evidence.en: Use precise terms such as 'edge', 'vertex', 'face' when describing 3-D shapes, and 'greater than', 'less than' when comparing numbers

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}以书面或口头形式表达数学答案时，是否会带上单位——例如写“5厘米”而不是只写“5”——并使用正确的符号，如=或<？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} writes or talks about a maths answer, do they include the units — like "5 centimetres" rather than just "5" — and use the right symbols like = or <?

description.zh: 寻找并运用数学结构：应用运算性质、位值规律和图形之间的关系来高效解决问题
description.en: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply properties of operations, place-value patterns, and relationships between shapes to solve problems efficiently

evidence.zh: 能主动运用交换律（如将3 + 9调整为9 + 3，从较大数开始数）。
evidence.en: Use the commutative property deliberately (e.g. reorder 3 + 9 as 9 + 3 to count on from the larger number)

evidence.zh: 能借助位值制进行整十数加减运算（如47+10=57，因为只有十位上的数发生变化）。
evidence.en: Use place-value structure to add or subtract tens (e.g. 47 + 10 = 57 because only the tens digit changes)

evidence.zh: 理解图形间的结构相似性（如长方形和正方形都有4条边和4个直角）
evidence.en: Recognise structural similarities between shapes (e.g. rectangles and squares both have 4 sides and 4 right angles)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在数学学习中注意到某种规律时——比如乘以10总是会在末尾添一个零——他们是否会运用这一规律更快地解决类似问题？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} notices a pattern in their maths work — like how multiplying by 10 always adds a zero — do they use that pattern to solve similar problems more quickly?

description.zh: 在面对多位数、小数和分数的算术问题时，能够有策略地选择和使用合适的工具与表示方法，包括在口算、草稿、正式算法和计算器之间做出选择。
description.en: Select and use appropriate tools and representations strategically, including choosing between mental methods, jottings, formal algorithms, and calculators for arithmetic with multi-digit numbers, decimals, and fractions

evidence.en: Choose a mental method for 345 + 200 but a written method for 345 + 278

evidence.zh: 能根据被测物体选择合适的刻度尺或米尺。
evidence.en: Select a ruler vs a metre stick based on the object being measured

evidence.zh: 判断在解决给定问题时，何时使用数轴比使用十进制积木更有效。
evidence.en: Decide when a number line is more useful than base-ten blocks for a given problem

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}面对一道数学题时，他们是否会思考哪种方法最合适——比如简单的题心算，较大的计算用笔算，几何题画示意图？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} faces a maths problem, do they think about which method suits it best — like doing easy ones in their head, using a written method for bigger calculations, or sketching a diagram for geometry?

description.zh: 识别并运用重复推理来归纳：扩展乘法表规律，从已知事实推导未知事实，并描述序列的规则。
description.en: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend multiplication table patterns, derive unknown facts from known ones, and describe rules for sequences

evidence.zh: 能识别4的倍数都是偶数，并据此检验答案。
evidence.en: Notice that all multiples of 4 are even and use this to check answers

evidence.zh: 能通过发现规律，由8×5+8×2推出8×7。
evidence.en: Derive 8 × 7 from 8 × 5 + 8 × 2 by spotting the pattern

evidence.zh: 描述递增模式的规律（如“每次加50”），并运用规律预测后续项。
evidence.en: Describe a rule for a growing pattern (e.g. 'add 50 each time') and use it to predict the next terms

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在学习乘法口诀表时，他们是否会利用已知的乘法事实来推算不确定的——例如，用5×6=30来推算出6×6=36？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is learning their times tables, do they use known facts to figure out ones they're not sure of — for example, using 5 × 6 = 30 to work out that 6 × 6 = 36?

description.zh: 构建并遵循多步数学论证；找出推理中的错误，并解释一种方法为什么有效或无效。
description.en: Construct and follow multi-step mathematical arguments; identify errors in reasoning and explain why a method works or does not work

evidence.zh: 逐步阐释竖式加法的算理。
evidence.en: Explain step by step why a columnar addition method gives the correct answer

evidence.zh: 在已解答的例题中识别并解释错误（如进位/退位错误）
evidence.en: Find and explain an error in a worked example (e.g. incorrect regrouping)

evidence.zh: 能为一般性结论提供简单证明（如“两个偶数之和必为偶数”）。
evidence.en: Construct a simple argument for why a general statement is true (e.g. 'adding two even numbers always gives an even number')

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}听了另一个孩子对某道数学题解法的解释，{{name}}能否判断这个推理是否合理——如果不合理，能否准确指出逻辑在哪里出了问题？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} hears another child's explanation for how they solved a maths problem, can {{name}} say whether the reasoning makes sense — and if not, point out exactly where the logic goes wrong?

description.zh: 在老师的支持下，将涉及较大数字或混合运算的多步问题分解成几个部分，选择策略，并检查答案是否合理——这个阶段的孩子在引导下正在养成这种习惯；独立评估策略是以后的事。
description.en: With teacher support, make sense of multi-step problems involving larger numbers or mixed operations by breaking them into parts, choosing strategies, and checking answers for reasonableness — children at this stage are developing the habit with guidance; independent strategy evaluation comes later

evidence.zh: 能将1000以内两步应用题分解为子问题并逐步求解。
evidence.en: Break a two-step word problem within 1000 into sub-problems and solve each part

evidence.zh: 计算前先估算，形成对结果合理性的判断。
evidence.en: Estimate an answer before calculating to set a reasonableness benchmark

evidence.zh: 运用多种方法或逆运算进行验算，必要时予以修正。
evidence.en: Check an answer using a different method or inverse operation and revise if needed

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}算出一道数学题的答案明显过大或过小，他们能否自己察觉并回头检查，而不需要你指出来？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} gets an answer that seems way too big or too small for a maths problem, do they notice and go back to check, even without you pointing it out?

description.zh: 寻找并运用数学结构：将位值规律应用于三位数运算，运用乘除法关系，并利用图形属性进行分类。
description.en: Look for and use mathematical structure: apply place-value patterns to three-digit operations, use multiplication/division relationships, and exploit shape properties to classify

evidence.zh: 能基于位值制说明：加整百数时，为什么只有百位上的数字发生变化。
evidence.en: Use the structure of place value to explain why adding hundreds only changes the hundreds digit

evidence.zh: 运用交换律及乘除法之间的关系推导未知的乘法事实
evidence.en: Use commutativity and the relationship between multiplication and division to derive unknown facts

evidence.zh: 能根据结构特征（边数、直角、平行线）对图形进行分类。
evidence.en: Classify shapes by their structural properties (number of sides, right angles, parallel lines)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在进行乘法运算或处理较大数字时，是否会运用位值或数关系方面的已有知识来简化计算——比如把24 × 3拆成20 × 3 + 4 × 3？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is multiplying or working with larger numbers, do they use what they know about place value or number relationships to simplify the calculation — like breaking 24 × 3 into 20 × 3 + 4 × 3?

description.zh: 在涉及三位数和分数的现实情境、图表和符号等式之间灵活转换，并解释每个部分所代表的含义
description.en: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, and symbolic equations involving three-digit numbers and fractions, explaining what each part represents

evidence.zh: 能在测量或金钱情境的应用题中列出三位数方程。
evidence.en: Write an equation with three-digit numbers to match a measurement or money word problem

evidence.zh: 能画条形模型表征分数问题，并借助模型解决问题
evidence.en: Draw a bar model to represent a fraction problem and use it to solve

evidence.zh: 阐明数轴图与应用题中数量的对应关系
evidence.en: Explain how a number line diagram relates to the quantities in a word problem

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在解决涉及分数或三位数的数学题时，能否在画图、使用数轴和列方程之间灵活切换，并解释每种方式所表示的含义？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} works through a maths problem involving fractions or three-digit numbers, can they switch between drawing a diagram, using a number line, and writing an equation — and explain what each one shows?

description.zh: 用数学语言精确表达：正确使用位值和分数词汇，在测量答案中注明单位，并准确使用符号
description.en: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct place-value and fraction vocabulary, specify units in measurement answers, and use notation accurately

evidence.zh: 在测量题作答中始终标注单位（如写“35厘米”而非“35”）。
evidence.en: Consistently specify units in measurement answers (e.g. '35 cm' not '35')

evidence.zh: 准确运用分数的相关术语（分子、分母、等值）。
evidence.en: Use fraction vocabulary precisely (numerator, denominator, equivalent)

evidence.zh: 能正确运用符号（包括£/p、>、<、=及分数符号）写出等式。
evidence.en: Write equations with correct notation including £/p, >, <, = and fraction symbols

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}给出涉及测量或分数的数学答案时，他们是否会包含正确的单位——如“3½米”或“2.5千克”——并在整个过程中使用正确的符号？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} gives a maths answer involving measurements or fractions, do they include the correct units — like "3½ metres" or "2.5 kg" — and use the right symbols throughout?

description.zh: 通过选择合适的表示方法并在情境中解释结果，来模拟涉及测量、金钱和时间的现实问题
description.en: Model real-world problems involving measurement, money, and time by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting results in context

evidence.zh: 针对测量问题，选择条形模型、数轴或方程。
evidence.en: Choose whether to use a bar model, number line, or equation for a measurement problem

evidence.zh: 能列方程解决多步货币问题，并将结果解释为找零或总花费
evidence.en: Model a multi-step money problem with equations and interpret the final answer as change or total cost

evidence.zh: 能根据测量数据绘制折线图，并据此解决实际问题。
evidence.en: Create a line plot from measurement data and use it to answer questions about the real-world situation

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}解决现实生活中的数学问题——比如计算一个项目需要多少布料时——他们能否选择正确的表征方式（图表、表格、方程），并解释答案在实际情况中意味着什么？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} solves a real-life maths problem — like calculating how much fabric is needed for a project — can they choose the right representation (a diagram, a table, an equation) and explain what the answer means in the real situation?

description.zh: 有策略地选择和使用合适的工具和表示方法：在口算、笔算和图示法之间做出选择；使用计算器进行检查；选择适合任务的分数模型
description.en: Select and use appropriate tools and representations strategically: choose between mental, written, and diagrammatic methods; use calculators for checking; select fraction models suited to the task

evidence.zh: 能判断25×4适合口算，而167×3适合笔算。
evidence.en: Decide to use mental multiplication for 25×4 but a written method for 167×3

evidence.zh: 借助分数条比较3/8和1/4（不使用数轴）
evidence.en: Choose fraction strips rather than a number line to compare 3/8 and 1/4

evidence.zh: 借助直尺和方格纸，先算长×宽，再用数方格验证面积。
evidence.en: Use a ruler and squared paper to verify area by counting squares after calculating l×w

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}做数学题时，他们是否会选择恰当的方法——对简单计算进行心算，对复杂计算写出解题步骤，并在遇到图形或分数题时画出示意图？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is working on maths, do they choose the right method — doing simple calculations in their head, using written working for complex ones, and sketching a diagram when a problem involves shapes or fractions?

description.zh: 在涉及乘法、分数和小数的现实情境、图表、数轴和符号等式之间灵活转换，并解释每种表示方式所展示的含义
description.en: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, and symbolic equations involving multiplication, fractions, and decimals, explaining what each representation shows

evidence.zh: 用分数图和除法算式表征分配问题
evidence.en: Represent a sharing problem as both a fraction diagram and a division equation

evidence.zh: 说明4×23的条形模型、面积模型与竖式方法之间的联系
evidence.en: Explain how a bar model for 4 × 23 connects to the area model and the written method

evidence.zh: 能在数轴上将小数转化为分数，并解释其等值关系
evidence.en: Translate a decimal on a number line into a fraction and explain the equivalence

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在解决涉及小数或分数的数学问题时，他们能否在分数条、数轴和书面算式之间进行转换——并解释每一种表示方式所展示的内容？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} works on a maths problem involving decimals or fractions, can they move between a fraction strip, a number line, and a written equation — explaining what each one is showing?

description.zh: 构建并呈现多步骤的数学论证；评价他人的推理，并清楚解释一种方法为什么有效或失败
description.en: Construct and present multi-step mathematical arguments; critique the reasoning of others and explain clearly why a method works or fails

evidence.zh: 能借助“分的份数越多，每份越小”解释为什么1/3 > 1/5。
evidence.en: Explain why 1/3 > 1/5 using the idea that more parts means smaller pieces

evidence.zh: 识别并解释同伴在退位竖式减法中的一个错误
evidence.en: Find and explain an error in a peer's column subtraction with exchanges
Present a chain of reasoning: since 6×8=48 and 6×2=12, then 6×10=60 so 6×8=60−12=48

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果学生说“分数相乘不可能得到更大的结果”，{{name}}能否想清楚这是否总是成立，并举例支持或反驳这个说法？
assessmentPrompt.en: If a classmate claims "you can't multiply a fraction and get a bigger answer", can {{name}} think through whether that's always true — and give an example to support or challenge the claim?

description.zh: 用精确的数学语言进行交流：正确使用分数和小数的词汇，准确说出角的类型，在测量和钱币中明确单位，并正确使用符号（=、<、>、÷、×）。
description.en: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct fraction/decimal vocabulary, name angle types accurately, specify units in measurement and money, and use notation (=, <, >, ÷, ×) correctly

evidence.zh: 能区分并正确使用“three fourths”和“three quarters”。
evidence.en: Distinguish between 'three fourths' and 'three quarters' and use both correctly

evidence.zh: 正确使用单位作答：写“63平方厘米”，而非仅写“63”。
evidence.en: State an answer in the correct unit: '63 square centimetres' not just '63'

evidence.zh: 能将24时计时法与普通计时法相互转换，并说明15:45与下午3:45的对应关系。
evidence.en: Write 15:45 in 24-hour notation and explain the distinction from 3:45 pm

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}书写涉及角度、分数或金钱的数学答案时，他们是否使用准确的术语和正确的符号——例如写“锐角”“3/4”或“£2.50”，而不是模糊的描述？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} writes up a maths answer involving angles, fractions, or money, do they use precise vocabulary and correct notation — like writing "acute angle", "3/4", or "£2.50" rather than vague descriptions?

description.zh: 通过选择适当的表示方法，对涉及乘法、面积、分数和单位换算的现实问题进行建模，并在情境中解释数学结果
description.en: Model real-world problems involving multiplication, area, fractions, and unit conversion by choosing appropriate representations and interpreting mathematical results in context

evidence.zh: 能借助阵列模型解决铺砖和面积问题，并列出相应的乘法算式。
evidence.en: Model a tiling/area problem with an array and write the corresponding multiplication

evidence.zh: 能将配方缩放问题转化为分数计算，并以克为单位解释结果
evidence.en: Represent a recipe-scaling problem as a fraction calculation and interpret the answer in grams

evidence.zh: 能借助条形模型进行米与厘米之间的单位换算。
evidence.en: Use a bar model to set up a unit conversion problem (metres to centimetres)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在解决实际问题时——比如计算一个房间的平方米面积——他们是否能选择正确的数学工具来解决问题，并结合实际情境解读最终得出的数字？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is solving a real-life problem — like working out the area of a room in square metres — do they choose the right maths tool for the job and interpret the final number in terms of the real situation?

description.zh: 通过识别子步骤、选择策略和监控进度，理解涉及四则运算、分数和面积/体积的多步骤问题
description.en: Make sense of multi-step problems involving four operations, fractions, and area/volume by identifying sub-steps, choosing a strategy, and monitoring progress

evidence.zh: 能分析两步应用题，并在计算前口述解题思路。
evidence.en: Break a two-step word problem into parts and explain a plan before calculating

evidence.zh: 针对周长问题，能选择画图或列方程。
evidence.en: Choose between drawing a diagram or writing equations for a perimeter problem

evidence.zh: 用估算检验“求一个数的几分之几”的答案：20的3/5一定大于20的一半。
evidence.en: Check a fraction-of-quantity answer by estimating: 3/5 of 20 must be more than half of 20

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}处理涉及面积、分数和多个步骤的复杂数学题时，他们是否会规划解题思路——在计算前先估算答案，并在最后检查答案是否合理？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} tackles a complex maths problem involving area, fractions, and multiple steps, do they plan their approach — estimating roughly what the answer should be before calculating, and then checking it makes sense at the end?

description.zh: 认识并运用重复推理来归纳：扩展乘法表和等值分数中的规律，从已知事实高效推导未知事实，描述一般规则
description.en: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in times tables and equivalent fractions, derive unknown facts from known facts efficiently, describe general rules

evidence.zh: 注意：凡是等于1/2的分数，分子都是分母的一半。
evidence.en: Notice that all fractions equivalent to 1/2 have a numerator that is half the denominator
Use the pattern 3×4=12, 3×40=120, 3×400=1200 and explain the generalisation

evidence.zh: 能由8×5=40和8×2=16推出8×7=56，并将该策略推广为一般方法。
evidence.en: Derive 8×7 from 8×5=40 plus 8×2=16 and describe the strategy as a general approach

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}注意到一个规律时——比如乘以4等同于翻倍两次——他们是否会运用这一概括来更高效地解决类似问题？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} notices a pattern — like that multiplying by 4 is the same as doubling twice — do they use that generalisation to solve similar problems more efficiently?

description.zh: 寻找并运用数学结构：利用位值规律计算×10/×100，运用分配律拆分乘法，应用分数等值性进行比较和计算，利用图形性质对四边形进行分类。
description.en: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit place-value patterns for ×10/×100, use the distributive property to break apart multiplications, apply fraction equivalence to compare and compute, use shape properties to classify quadrilaterals

evidence.zh: 能运用分配律将7×13拆分为7×10+7×3。
evidence.en: Decompose 7×13 into 7×10 + 7×3 using the distributive property

evidence.zh: 能借助位值制解释乘10时数字为何左移一位。
evidence.en: Explain why multiplying by 10 shifts digits one place left using place-value structure

evidence.zh: 运用正方形是特殊矩形这一事实，推导四边形的性质
evidence.en: Use the fact that a square is a special rectangle to reason about quadrilateral properties

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在比较分数或计算百分比时，他们是否会寻找底层规律——比如发现50%总是等于一半，或者等值分数在数轴上总是位于同一个点？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is comparing fractions or working out a percentage, do they look for underlying patterns — like spotting that 50% is always half, or that equivalent fractions all sit at the same point on a number line?

name.zh: 策略性地选择表示方法

description.zh: 根据问题的需求，策略性地选择和使用工具与表示方法：在口算方法、正式笔算方法、量角器、分数条和图表之间进行选择。
description.en: Select and use tools and representations strategically: choose between mental methods, formal written methods, protractors, fraction strips, and diagrams based on the demands of the problem

evidence.zh: 25 × 40 用口算乘法，347 × 26 用笔算乘法。
evidence.en: Choose mental multiplication for 25 × 40 but long multiplication for 347 × 26

evidence.zh: 用量角器测量验证估测角度，而非仅凭目测。
evidence.en: Select a protractor to verify an estimated angle rather than relying on visual inspection alone

evidence.zh: 能运用通分或基准比较法对分数进行排序，并说明理由。
evidence.en: Choose a common-denominator approach vs. benchmark comparison for ordering fractions, and explain why

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}面对几何或比例问题时，他们是否会选择正确的工具——比如用量角器测量角度，或用分数条比较分数——而不是总是默认使用同一种方法？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} faces a geometry or proportion problem, do they choose the right tool — like a protractor for angles or a fraction strip for comparing fractions — rather than always defaulting to one method?

description.zh: 通过分析已知和未知条件，规划多步策略，并利用估算和逆运算评估合理性，来理解和解决涉及大数、分数、小数和百分比的复杂多步问题。
description.en: Make sense of complex multi-step problems involving large numbers, fractions, decimals, and percentages by analysing what is known and unknown, planning multi-step strategies, and evaluating reasonableness through estimation and inverse operations

evidence.zh: 能将含单位换算与乘法的三步应用题分解为子问题，并依次求解。
evidence.en: Break a three-step problem involving unit conversion and multiplication into sub-problems and solve systematically
Estimate 4,832 × 7 as roughly 5,000 × 7 = 35,000 to check a calculated answer of 33,824

evidence.zh: 能在具体情境中判断百分比结果超过100%是不合理的。
evidence.en: Identify that a percentage answer over 100% doesn't make sense in context

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}面对涉及百分比、大数或分数的复杂多步骤数学题时，他们是否会停下来先明确已知条件、估算答案，然后再检查最终结果是否合理？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} faces a complex multi-step maths problem involving percentages, large numbers, or fractions, do they pause to identify what's known, estimate an answer, and then check their final result makes sense?

description.zh: 寻找并运用数学结构：利用分数、小数和百分数之间的关系；使用因数对简化乘法；应用角度事实求未知角；系统地使用正多边形的性质
description.en: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the relationship between fractions, decimals, and percentages; use factor pairs to simplify multiplication; apply angle facts to find unknowns; use properties of regular polygons systematically

evidence.en: Use the structure 25 × 16 = 25 × 4 × 4 = 100 × 4 = 400 by exploiting factor pairs

evidence.zh: 理解0.75 = 3/4 = 75%，并能根据需要选择最简形式。
evidence.en: Recognise that 0.75 = 3/4 = 75% and use whichever form is most efficient for the problem

evidence.zh: 运用平角为180°这一事实作为结构性工具求未知角。
evidence.en: Use the fact that angles on a straight line sum to 180° as a structural tool to find missing angles

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}认识到分数、小数和百分数只是同一数量的不同表示形式时，他们能否运用这一理解，在计算更简便时灵活地在三者之间进行转换？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} notices that fractions, decimals, and percentages are just different ways of writing the same thing, do they use that understanding to switch between them fluidly when it makes a calculation easier?

description.zh: 在现实情境、图表、数轴、条形模型和符号等式之间灵活转换，涉及多位数乘法、分数、小数和百分数，并能解释不同表示方式之间的联系。
description.en: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, number lines, bar models, and symbolic equations involving multi-digit multiplication, fractions, decimals, and percentages, explaining connections between representations

evidence.zh: 能用条形模型和乘法算式表示缩放问题
evidence.en: Represent a scaling problem as both a bar model and a multiplication equation

evidence.zh: 在百格图上表示0.35、35/100和35%表示同一个量。
evidence.en: Show how 0.35, 35/100, and 35% all represent the same quantity on a hundredths grid

evidence.zh: 能根据折线图上的数据列出减法算式并计算差值
evidence.en: Translate a line-graph reading into a subtraction equation to find the difference

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}解决涉及百分比或多位数乘法的问题时，他们能否用条形模型、数轴和方程来表示同一情境，并解释每种表示方式所代表的含义？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} solves a problem involving percentages or multi-digit multiplication, can they show the same situation using a bar model, a number line, and an equation — and explain what each one represents?

description.zh: 用数学的精确性进行交流：正确使用质数、因数、倍数、角类型和多边形规则性的词汇；指定单位，包括平方厘米、立方米、度；准确使用平方/立方的记法和百分比
description.en: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary for primes, factors, multiples, angle types, and polygon regularity; specify units including cm², m³, °; use notation for squares/cubes and percentages accurately

evidence.zh: 在书面解释中区分“因数”与“倍数”
evidence.en: Distinguish 'factor' from 'multiple' in a written explanation

evidence.zh: 面积答案必须带单位，写成48 cm²（不能只写48）；体积估算须写成约60 cm³。
evidence.en: Write an area answer as 48 cm² (not just 48) and a volume estimate as approximately 60 cm³

evidence.zh: 正确运用5²的记法，并读作“五的平方”
evidence.en: Use 5² notation correctly and read it as 'five squared'

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在口头或书面表达中涉及质数、百分比或几何图形等数学内容时，能否准确且自信地使用“质因数”“钝角”或“正六边形”等专业术语？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} talks or writes about maths involving primes, percentages, or polygons, do they use the precise technical words — like "prime factor", "obtuse angle", or "regular hexagon" — correctly and confidently?

description.zh: 通过选择适当的数学表示方法，对涉及比例缩放、单位换算、面积/周长和百分比的现实世界问题进行建模，并在情境中解释结果。
description.en: Model real-world problems involving scaling, unit conversion, area/perimeter, and percentage by selecting appropriate mathematical representations and interpreting results in context

evidence.zh: 运用乘法和分数建立食谱缩放问题的模型，并以克为单位解释答案
evidence.en: Model a recipe-scaling problem with multiplication and fractions, then interpret the answer in grams

evidence.zh: 能画比例模型并用面积公式解决铺地毯问题
evidence.en: Represent a room-carpet problem by drawing a scale diagram and applying the area formula

evidence.zh: 运用百分数条形模型计算折扣价，并结合英镑解释结果。
evidence.en: Use a percentage bar model to find a sale price and explain the answer in £

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在解决现实生活中的数学问题（如按比例调整食谱或进行单位换算）时，他们是否会选择合理的表征方式、完成数学运算，并解释结果在实际情况中的意义？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is solving a real-world maths problem — like scaling a recipe or converting units — do they choose a sensible representation, carry out the maths, and then explain what the result means in the real situation?

description.zh: 识别并运用重复推理进行概括：扩展等值分数和百分比转换的模式，从已知事实推导未知事实，描述数列的一般规律并预测项
description.en: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: extend patterns in equivalent fractions and percentage conversions, derive unknown facts from known facts, describe general rules for sequences and predict terms

evidence.zh: 理解任意数乘25可先乘100再除以4，并能解释其算理。
evidence.en: Notice that multiplying any number by 25 can be done by multiplying by 100 then dividing by 4, and explain why

evidence.zh: 能描述数列的规律并预测第20项
evidence.en: Describe the general rule for a sequence and predict the 20th term

evidence.zh: 一般化：求10%除以10，求5%取10%的一半，并以此求任意数的35%。
evidence.en: Generalise: to find 10% divide by 10, to find 5% halve 10%, and use this to find 35% of any number

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}看到一组等值分数——比如1/2、2/4、3/6……——他们能否描述其中的规律，并运用该规律找出接下来的几项，或在分数与百分数之间快速换算？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} sees a sequence of equivalent fractions — like 1/2, 2/4, 3/6… — can they describe the rule and use it to find the next few terms, or to quickly convert between fractions and percentages?

description.zh: 构建并展示包含多个步骤的逻辑数学论证；评价他人关于分数、角度或计算的推理，并清楚地解释错误或替代方法。
description.en: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps; critique others' reasoning about fractions, angles, or calculations and clearly explain errors or alternative methods

evidence.zh: 借助通分和直观模型，证明3/4 > 2/3。
evidence.en: Prove that 3/4 > 2/3 using a common denominator argument and a visual model

evidence.zh: 在长乘法中识别并解释因部分积未对齐而导致的错误
evidence.en: Find and explain an error in a long multiplication where a partial product was misaligned

evidence.zh: 通过撕拼法展示推理过程，说明三角形内角和为180°。
evidence.en: Present a chain of reasoning to show that angles in a triangle sum to 180° by tearing and arranging

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}和同学用不同方法解同一道数学题，{{name}}能否比较这两种方法，说明哪种方法更高效，并指出任一种解法中的错误？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} and a classmate solve the same maths problem differently, can {{name}} compare the two approaches, explain which method is more efficient, and identify any errors in either working?

description.zh: 用数学的精确性进行交流：正确使用比、比例、代数、体积、坐标几何和圆的部分的词汇；指定单位，包括立方厘米、立方米和英里/公里；准确使用代数表达式和运算顺序的符号
description.en: Communicate with mathematical precision: use correct vocabulary for ratio, proportion, algebra, volume, coordinate geometry, and circle parts; specify units including cm³, m³, and miles/km; use notation for algebraic expressions and order of operations accurately

evidence.zh: 能正确运用“半径”“直径”和“周长”描述圆。
evidence.en: Use 'radius', 'diameter', and 'circumference' correctly when describing a circle

evidence.zh: 在数学表达中区分表达式、方程和公式。
evidence.en: Distinguish between an expression, an equation, and a formula in mathematical writing

evidence.zh: 在呈现体积计算结果时，能正确标注单位（如60 cm³，而非仅写60）。
evidence.en: Specify units correctly when presenting volume calculations (e.g. 60 cm³ not just 60)

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}撰写涉及代数或三维图形的数学内容时，他们是否使用精确的语言——如“代数式”“立方厘米”或“坐标”——并在全文中应用正确的符号表示？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} writes up maths involving algebra or 3-D shapes, do they use precise language — like "algebraic expression", "cubic centimetres", or "coordinates" — and apply the correct notation throughout?

description.zh: 通过分析已知量和未知量、规划解题策略、利用估算和逆运算评估合理性，理解涉及比、比例、代数、负数以及分数和小数四则运算的复杂多步问题。
description.en: Make sense of complex multi-step problems involving ratio, proportion, algebra, negative numbers, and all four operations with fractions and decimals by analysing given and unknown quantities, planning solution strategies, and evaluating reasonableness using estimation and inverse operations

evidence.zh: 能将三步比例问题分解为子问题，并规划解题步骤
evidence.en: Break down a three-step ratio problem into sub-problems and plan a solution pathway

evidence.zh: 在代数应用题中识别已知量和未知量，并列出方程。
evidence.en: Identify which quantities are known/unknown in an algebraic word problem and set up equations

evidence.zh: 在得出最终答案前，能通过估算判断小数除法的结果是否合理。
evidence.en: Use estimation to check whether a decimal division answer is reasonable before finalising

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}面对涉及代数、比或分数的多步骤复杂数学题时，他们是否会将其拆解为可处理的部分，估算合理答案，并用不同方法验证结果？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} faces a complex maths problem involving algebra, ratio, or fractions with multiple steps, do they break it into manageable parts, estimate what's reasonable, and verify their answer using a different approach?

description.zh: 根据问题的需求，有策略地选择和使用工具与表示方法：在脑算方法、正式笔算方法、代数方法、坐标网格和技术工具之间做出选择
description.en: Select and use tools and representations strategically: choose between mental methods, formal written methods, algebraic approaches, coordinate grids, and technology based on the demands of the problem

evidence.zh: 解释为何对于4,752 ÷ 13，长除法比心算方法更适用。
evidence.en: Explain why long division is more appropriate than mental methods for 4,752 ÷ 13

evidence.zh: 能借助坐标网格法验证平移，而非仅依据文字描述进行运算。
evidence.en: Choose a coordinate grid approach to verify a translation rather than computing from a description alone

evidence.zh: 能选择公式法而非数单位小方块来快速计算体积
evidence.en: Select a formula-based approach rather than counting cubes to find volume efficiently

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}选择如何解决一道数学题时，他们是否会选择最高效的方法——用代数处理复杂的推广问题，用坐标网格解决几何问题，还是用口算处理简单的计算？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} chooses how to tackle a maths problem, do they pick the most efficient approach — using algebra for a complex generalisation, a coordinate grid for a geometry problem, or mental arithmetic for a simple calculation?

description.zh: 构建并展示涉及多个步骤和形式推理的逻辑数学论证；对他人关于分数、代数、比或几何的推理进行评判，并清楚地解释错误或替代方法。
description.en: Construct and present logical mathematical arguments involving multiple steps and formal reasoning; critique others' reasoning about fractions, algebra, ratio, or geometry and clearly explain errors or alternative approaches

evidence.zh: 运用逻辑顺序建立角的关联，证明指定角为60°。
evidence.en: Prove that a given angle must be 60° by chaining angle facts in a logical sequence

evidence.zh: 能发现并指出同伴在分数除法计算中的错误
evidence.en: Find and explain the error in a peer's fraction division calculation

evidence.zh: 能举出反例来推翻错误猜想（如“乘法总使数变大”）。
evidence.en: Construct a counter-example to disprove a false conjecture (e.g. 'multiplying always makes bigger')

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}展示多步数学解题过程时，他们是否能清晰呈现推理过程，使他人能够理解每一步——并且如果一道已解答的题目中存在逻辑错误，他们能否发现其中的问题？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} presents a multi-step maths solution, do they lay out their reasoning clearly enough that someone else could follow every step — and can they spot the flaw if a worked solution contains a logical error?

name.zh: 通过重复推理进行概括

description.zh: 认识并运用重复推理进行概括：描述第n项的代数规则，利用运算性质简化，并用具体例子验证概括
description.en: Recognise and use repeated reasoning to generalise: describe algebraic rules for nth terms, use properties of operations to simplify, and verify generalisations with specific cases

evidence.zh: 能根据三角形、四边形、五边形的规律，说明n边形的内角和为(n−2)×180°。
evidence.en: Explain that the interior angle sum of an n-sided polygon is (n−2) × 180° based on the pattern for triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons

evidence.zh: 能识别并运用通项公式，预测线性数列的第20项
evidence.en: Predict the 20th term of a linear sequence by identifying and applying the general rule

evidence.zh: 推广可得：任意整数除以n，写成分数时总以n作分母。
evidence.en: Generalise that dividing by n always gives a denominator of n in the fraction, for any whole numbers

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}发现数列的规律时——例如“每次加7”或“项数乘以3”——他们能否运用该规律直接求出任意一项，而无须逐一列出前面所有的项？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} finds the rule for a number sequence — like "add 7 each time" or "multiply the position number by 3" — can they use that rule to find any term without having to list all the ones before it?

description.zh: 寻找并运用数学结构：利用二维图形的层级关系推导性质；运用运算顺序和代数结构简化表达式；联系分数、小数、百分数的等价关系；利用比的结构高效解决比例问题。
description.en: Look for and use mathematical structure: exploit the hierarchy of 2-D shapes to deduce properties; use order of operations and algebraic structure to simplify expressions; connect fraction–decimal–percentage equivalences; use ratio structure to solve proportion problems efficiently

evidence.zh: 运用矩形都是平行四边形的性质，推导缺失的角度关系
evidence.en: Use the property that all rectangles are parallelograms to deduce missing angle facts

evidence.zh: 能运用分配律的结构，识别3 × (n + 5) = 3n + 15。
evidence.en: Recognise that 3 × (n + 5) = 3n + 15 by applying distributive structure

evidence.zh: 灵活运用1/8 = 0.125 = 12.5%的等价关系解决比较问题
evidence.en: Use the equivalence 1/8 = 0.125 = 12.5% flexibly to solve a comparison problem

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在化简代数式或比较比时，是否会寻找其内在结构——比如运用运算顺序或发现两个比等价——以使计算更高效？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is simplifying an algebraic expression or comparing ratios, do they look for the underlying structure — like using the order of operations or spotting that two ratios are equivalent — to make the calculation more efficient?

description.zh: 使用合适的工具、图表或方程，对涉及比、比例尺、体积、单位换算和比例推理的现实世界问题进行建模。
description.en: Model real-world problems involving ratio, scale, volume, unit conversion, and proportional reasoning with appropriate tools, diagrams, or equations

evidence.zh: 能选用条形模型或双数轴表征比例问题并求解
evidence.en: Choose a bar model or double number line to represent a ratio problem and solve it

evidence.zh: 能在带标注的示意图辅助下建立体积问题模型，套用公式进行计算，并结合具体情境解释计算结果。
evidence.en: Model a volume problem with a labelled diagram, apply the formula, and interpret the result in context

evidence.zh: 能判断测量结果是否需要取近似值，并确定其精确度。
evidence.en: Determine whether a measurement answer should be rounded and to what degree of accuracy

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}运用数学解决实际问题时——例如计算容器容积或算出百分比折扣——他们能否判断答案需要精确到什么程度，并结合情境解释其含义？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} uses maths to solve a real problem — like calculating the volume of a container or working out a percentage discount — do they decide how precise their answer needs to be and explain what it means in context?

description.zh: 在涉及分数、比例和代数的实际问题、图表、坐标网格、代数表达式、表格和符号方程之间流畅转换，并解释不同表示方式之间的联系。
description.en: Move fluently between real-world situations, diagrams, coordinate grids, algebraic expressions, tables, and symbolic equations involving fractions, ratio, and algebra, explaining connections between representations

evidence.zh: 能将应用题转化为代数方程，并用条形模型表示。
evidence.en: Translate a word problem into an algebraic equation and also represent it on a bar model

evidence.zh: 能在坐标网格上根据表格数据描点，并说明其关系
evidence.en: Plot data from a table onto a coordinate grid and interpret the relationship

evidence.zh: 解释扇形图、分数和百分数如何表示同一比例
evidence.en: Explain how a pie chart, a fraction, and a percentage all represent the same proportion

assessmentPrompt.zh: 当{{name}}在解决代数或比例问题时，能否在图像、数值表、书面方程式和现实情境之间灵活转换，并解释每种表示方式如何体现同一关系？
assessmentPrompt.en: When {{name}} is working on an algebra or ratio problem, can they move fluidly between a graph, a table of values, a written equation, and a real-world story — explaining how each representation shows the same relationship?

description.zh: 使用满、空、多于、少于、半满等语言比较和描述容量和体积
description.en: Compare and describe capacity and volume using language such as full, empty, more than, less than, half full

evidence.zh: 通过比较两个容器，判断哪个装得更多或更少。
evidence.en: Compare two containers and say which holds more/less

evidence.zh: 能用“半满”和“四分之一满”描述容器的盛装状态
evidence.en: Use 'half full' and 'quarter full' to describe a container

evidence.zh: 能解决“哪杯水更多”等实际问题
evidence.en: Solve practical problems like 'Which cup has more water?'

assessmentPrompt.zh: 如果{{name}}有两个大小不同的杯子，他们能否告诉你哪个装水更多——并能说出其中一个比另一个“更满”或“更不满”？
assessmentPrompt.en: If {{name}} has two cups of different sizes, can they tell you which holds more water — and describe one as "more full" or "less full" than the other?
